verses.translation: Yudhisthira said " Virtuous one! through your grace, I liavo heard about various kinds of Dharmas, hut I feel eager to hear more about them which please narrate to me. First of all, please explain to me how the Narmada came into existence." — 0-7.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yudhisthira said " Virtuous one! through your grace, I liavo heard about various kinds of Dharmas, hut I feel eager to hear more about them which please narrate to me. First of all, please explain to me how the Narmada came into existence." — 0-7.
verses.science: होती है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुरशीतिकैश्चैव कलिजैरङ्गुलैः स्मृतम् आ पादतलमस्तको नवतालो भवेत्तु यः
verses.transliteration: caturaśītikaiścaiva kalijairaṅgulaiḥ smṛtam ā pādatalamastako navatālo bhavettu yaḥ
verses.translation: M&rkandcya said: — "The Narmada is the foremost among all the rivers, it is the dispeller of everybody's sins. King Yudliisthira! the glory of the sacred Narmada as [ have read in several Puranas, I shall ex- plain to you. Sacred is the river CSaiiges at Kankhala, sacred is Sarasvati in Kuruksetra. The sacred Narmada is supreme everywhere — in the forest as well as in places of habitation. The waters of the Sarasvati purify one in course of five days, those of the YamuiiA in seven days, of the Ganges instantaneously, and of the Narmada at the mere sight of it.
verses.hindi: जिसका शरीर पैरसे लेकर मस्तकपर्यन्त नौ बित्ता-(एक सौ आठ अंगुल)-का होता है तथा भुजाएँ जानुतक लम्बी होती हैं, उसका देवतालोग भी आदर करते हैं। प्रत्येक युगमें गौओं, हाथियों, भैंसों और स्थावर प्राणियोंके शरीरोंका हृस एवं वृद्धि इसी क्रमसे जाननी चाहिये। पशु अपने कुकुद् (मौर)-तक छिहत्तर अंगुल ऊँचा होता है। हाथियोंके शरीरकी ऊँचाई एक सौ आठ अंगुलकी बतलायी जाती है। वृक्षोंकी अधिक-से-अधिक ऊँचाई एक हजार बानबे अंगुलकी होती है। मनुष्यके शरीरका जैसा आकार-प्रकार होता है, वही लक्षण वंशपरम्परावश देवताओंमें भी देखा जाता है। देवताओंका शरीर केवल बुद्धिकी अतिशयतासे युक्त बतलाया जाता है। मानव-शरीरमें बुद्धिकी उतनी अधिकता नहीं रहती। इस प्रकार देवताओं और मानवोंके शरीरोंमें उत्पन्न हुए जो भाव हैं, वे पशुओं, पक्षियों और स्थावर प्राणियोंके शरीरोंमें भी पाये जाते हैं। गौ, बकरा, घोड़ा, हाथी, पक्षी और मृग—इनका सर्वत्र यज्ञीय कर्मोंमें उपयोग होता है तथा ये पशुमूर्तियाँ क्रमश: देवताओंके उपभोगमें प्रयुक्त होती हैं। उन उपभोक्ता देवताओंके रूप और प्रमाणके अनुरूप ही उन चर-अचर प्राणियोंकी मूर्तियाँ होती हैं। वे उन मनोज्ञ भोगोंका उपभोग करके सुखका अनुभव करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: M&rkandcya said: — "The Narmada is the foremost among all the rivers, it is the dispeller of everybody's sins. King Yudliisthira! the glory of the sacred Narmada as [ have read in several Puranas, I shall ex- plain to you. Sacred is the river CSaiiges at Kankhala,…
verses.commentary: Sense: M&rkandcya said: — "The Narmada is the foremost among all the rivers, it is the dispeller of everybody's sins. King Yudliisthira! the glory of the sacred Narmada as [ have read in several Puranas, I shall ex- plain to you. Sacred is the river CSaiiges at Kankhala,…
verses.science: मौनधारण-ये स्त्रियोंके लिये प्रशस्त नहीं हैं। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: संहृत्याजानुबाहुश्च दैवतैरभिपूज्यते गवां च हस्तिनां चैव महिषस्थावरात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: saṃhṛtyājānubāhuśca daivatairabhipūjyate gavāṃ ca hastināṃ caiva mahiṣasthāvarātmanām
verses.translation: GHAPTEB CLXXXVI.
verses.commentary: Sense: GHAPTEB CLXXXVI.
verses.science: अनौपम्या बोली--नारदजी ! पता नहीं, इस जन्ममें या पूर्व जन्ममें किये हुए पुण्यसे ही आपका यहाँ आगमन। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रमेणैतेन विज्ञेये ह्रासवृद्धी युगे युगे षट्सप्तत्यङ्गुलोत्सेधः पशुर् आककुदो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: krameṇaitena vijñeye hrāsavṛddhī yuge yuge ṣaṭsaptatyaṅgulotsedhaḥ paśur ākakudo bhavet
verses.translation: The NarmadA is most charming and attractive of the country of Kalinga, the forest of Amarakantaka, and of all the three realms. — 8-12,
verses.commentary: Sense: The NarmadA is most charming and attractive of the country of Kalinga, the forest of Amarakantaka, and of all the three realms. — 8-12,
verses.science: भवदागमनं भूतं किंचित् पृच्छाम्यहं ब्रतम्॥ ३९ हुआ है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुलानामष्टशतम् उत्सेधो हस्तिनां स्मृतः अङ्गुलानां सहस्रं तु द्विचत्वारिंशदङ्गुलम्
verses.transliteration: aṅgulānāmaṣṭaśatam utsedho hastināṃ smṛtaḥ aṅgulānāṃ sahasraṃ tu dvicatvāriṃśadaṅgulam
verses.translation: King! the Devas, the demons, the Gandharvas, the ascetics, the Risis — they all attain emancipation on the banks of the NarmadA. One who follows the prescribed order of religion and observes a complete fast for a day, after bathing in the Narmada, liberates his seven genera- tions from sin. The manes of those who offer them libations at Jalesvara, after bahting in it, remain happy till the end of the cycle. — 13-15.
verses.wordMeaning: King! the Devas, the demons, the Gandharvas, the ascetics, the Risis — they all attain emancipation on the banks of the NarmadA. One who follows the prescribed order of religion and observes a complete fast for a day, after bathing in the Narmada,…
verses.commentary: Sense: King! the Devas, the demons, the Gandharvas, the ascetics, the Risis — they all attain emancipation on the banks of the NarmadA. One who follows the prescribed order of religion and observes a complete fast for a day, after bathing in the Narmada,…
verses.science: अनेन पार्वती देवी चीर्णेन वरवर्णिनि शंकरस्य शरीरस्था विष्णोर्लक्ष्मीस्तथैव च। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शतार्धमङ्गुलानां तु ह्य् उत्सेधः शाखिनां परः मानुषस्य शरीरस्य संनिवेशस्तु यादृशः
verses.transliteration: śatārdhamaṅgulānāṃ tu hy utsedhaḥ śākhināṃ paraḥ mānuṣasya śarīrasya saṃniveśastu yādṛśaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Siva becomes pleased with one who bathes in the NarmadS, near the hill abounding with the group of Rudras, and worships Them with sandal, flower and incense. The Lord is enshrined close to that hill, to the west, where one ought to offer libations to the manes with devotion and by keeping one's passions under control. Libations of water mixed with barley should be offered to the Devas, and water mixed with sesamum should be offered to the rnanes. One who does so makes his seven generations go to the heaven, and he himself enjoys in heaven for 60,000 years with the celestial nymphs, the Gandharvas and the Siddhas. Afterwards ho is born as a wealthy man; and, after a life of charities ho returns to the very same sanctified place. — 16-22.
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Siva becomes pleased with one who bathes in the NarmadS, near the hill abounding with the group of Rudras, and worships Them with sandal, flower and incense. The Lord is enshrined close to that hill, to the west,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Siva becomes pleased with one who bathes in the NarmadS, near the hill abounding with the group of Rudras, and worships Them with sandal, flower and incense. The Lord is enshrined close to that hill, to the west,…
verses.science: एवं श्रुत्वा तु शुश्रोणि यथेष्टं कर्त्तुमर्हसि। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तल्लक्षणं तु देवानां दृश्यते ऽन्वयदर्शनात् बुद्ध्यातिशयसंयुक्तो देवानां काय उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tallakṣaṇaṃ tu devānāṃ dṛśyate 'nvayadarśanāt buddhyātiśayasaṃyukto devānāṃ kāya ucyate
verses.translation: Then he goes to tlie domain of liva, after liberating his seven generations from sin. The length of the Narmada is 100 yojanas, and its breadth is 16 miles. There are 60,00,60,000 of tirthas round the Narmadih One who is calm and has his passions under his control, free from anger, and the sin of causing pain to others, and is a benefactor of
verses.wordMeaning: Then he goes to tlie domain of liva, after liberating his seven generations from sin. The length of the Narmada is 100 yojanas, and its breadth is 16 miles. There are 60,00,60,000 of tirthas round the Narmadih One who is calm and has his passions under his control,…

verses.science: ततो ह्यह्ृष्टहृदया अन्यतोगतमानसाः। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: तथा नातिशयश्चैव मानुषः काय उच्यते इत्येव हि परिक्रान्ता भावा ये दिव्यमानुषाः
verses.transliteration: tathā nātiśayaścaiva mānuṣaḥ kāya ucyate ityeva hi parikrāntā bhāvā ye divyamānuṣāḥ
verses.translation: all the beings and a devotee to the Lord iva, if he happens to die at the banka of the Narmadil,, resides in heaven for a century, consisting of the length of days of the gods. There he is in the company of the nymphs, and is adored by the Siddhas and the Gandharvas with incense, flowers, &c. Ho has also the privilege to live in the company of the Devas of all classes; and, on being re-born, becomes a most illustrious king! There, he is the owner of a majestic palace, studded with jewels and supported on mighty pillars of precious stones, surrounded by a large retinue of servants and maids. Majestic elephants and a multitude of neighing horses adorn his gateway. — 23-31.
verses.wordMeaning: all the beings and a devotee to the Lord iva, if he happens to die at the banka of the Narmadil,, resides in heaven for a century, consisting of the length of days of the gods. There he is in the company of the nymphs,…
verses.commentary: Sense: all the beings and a devotee to the Lord iva, if he happens to die at the banka of the Narmadil,, resides in heaven for a century, consisting of the length of days of the gods. There he is in the company of the nymphs,…
verses.science: नामकी मेरी ननद है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: पशूनां पक्षिणां चैव स्थावराणां च सर्वशः गावो ऽजाश्वाश्च विज्ञेया हस्तिनः पक्षिणो मृगाः
verses.transliteration: paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ caiva sthāvarāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ gāvo 'jāśvāśca vijñeyā hastinaḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ
verses.translation: His gateway is also illustrious like that of Indra. In such a place he is the beloved lord of beautiful ladies, and enjoys liimself for a divine century, without being oppressed with any kind of disease. — 32-33.
verses.commentary: Sense: His gateway is also illustrious like that of Indra. In such a place he is the beloved lord of beautiful ladies, and enjoys liimself for a divine century, without being oppressed with any kind of disease. — 32-33.
verses.science: उपवास-व्रतसे तुम्हारा पति भी तुम्हारे अधीन रहेगा तथा सास और श्वशुरका भी मुख बंद हो जायगा अर्थात् वे तुमसे प्रेम करने लगेंगे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपयुक्ताः क्रियास्वेते यज्ञियास्त्विह सर्वशः यथाक्रमोपभोगाश्च देवानां पशुमूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: upayuktāḥ kriyāsvete yajñiyāstviha sarvaśaḥ yathākramopabhogāśca devānāṃ paśumūrtayaḥ
verses.translation: One who dies at Amarakantaka gets many blessings and never perisbee by fire, poison drowning. He gets the power of moving about in the space with tlie rapidity of the wind. The man who dies at Amaresa is blessed with all kinds of enjoyments including 3,000 maids who are at his command for a considerable length of time. One who offers flowers, in- cense, &c.y to the Rudras enshrined round the hill, after having his ablution in the river, undoubtedly wins the pleasure of all of Them. — 34-38.
verses.wordMeaning: One who dies at Amarakantaka gets many blessings and never perisbee by fire, poison drowning. He gets the power of moving about in the space with tlie rapidity of the wind.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One who dies at Amarakantaka gets many blessings and never perisbee by fire, poison drowning. He gets the power of moving about in the space with tlie rapidity of the wind.…
verses.science: दूँगी। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां रूपानुरूपैश्च प्रमाणैः स्थिरजङ्गमाः मनोज्ञैस्तत्र तैर्भोगैः सुखिनो ह्युपपेदिरे
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ rūpānurūpaiśca pramāṇaiḥ sthirajaṅgamāḥ manojñaistatra tairbhogaiḥ sukhino hyupapedire
verses.translation: To the west of the hill is enshrined Lord Maherfvara, where one who offers libations, according to the prescribed rituals to the Devas and the Pitfis after his bath, is the bestower of heaven on his seven generations and he himself resides in heaven for sixty divine years, where various

verses.science: इति श्रीमत्स्ये महापुराणे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये ससाशीत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः इस प्रकार श्रीमत्स्यमहापुराणमें नर्मदामाहात्म्य-वर्णन नामक एक सौ सतासीवाँ अध्याय सम्पूर्ण हुआ। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ शिष्टान्प्रवक्ष्यामि साधूनथ ततश्च वै ब्राह्मणाः श्रुतिशब्दाश्च देवानां पशुमूर्तयः संयुज्य ब्रह्मणा ह्यन्तस् तेन सन्तः प्रचक्षते

verses.hindi: अब मैं संतों तथा साधुओंका वर्णन कर रहा हूँ। ब्राह्मण ग्रन्थ और श्रुतियोंके शब्द—ये भी देवताओंकी निर्देशिका-मूर्तियाँ हैं। अन्त:करणमें इनके तथा ब्रह्मका संयोग बना रहता है, इसलिये ये संत कहलाते हैं। ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय और वैश्य सामान्य एवं विशेष धर्मोंमें सर्वत्र श्रौत एवं स्मार्त विधिके अनुसार कर्मका आचरण करते हैं। वर्णाश्रम-धर्मोंके पालनमें तत्पर तथा स्वर्ग-प्राप्तिमें सुख माननेवाले लोगोंद्वारा आचरित जो श्रुति एवं स्मृतिसम्बन्धी धर्म है, उसे ज्ञानधर्म कहा जाता है। दिव्य सिद्धियोंकी साधनामें संलग्न तथा गुरुका हितैषी होनेके कारण ब्रह्मचारीको साधु कहते हैं। (अन्य आश्रमोंकी जीविकाका) निमित्त तथा स्वयं साधनामें निरत होनेके कारण गृहस्थ भी साधु कहलाता है। वनमें तपस्या करनेवाला साधु वैखानस नामसे अभिहित होता है। योगकी साधनामें प्रयत्नशील संन्यासीको भी साधु कहते हैं। ‘धर्म’ शब्द क्रियात्मक है और यह धर्माचरणमें ही प्रयुक्त होनेवाला कहा गया है। सामर्थ्यशाली भगवान्‌ने धर्मको कल्याणकारक और अधर्मको अनिष्टकारक बतलाया है तथा देवता, पितर, ऋषि और मानव ‘यह धर्म है और यह धर्म नहीं है’ ऐसा कहकर मौन धारण कर लेते हैं। ‘धृ’ धातु धारण करने तथा महत्त्वके अर्थमें प्रयुक्त होती है। अधारण एवं अधर्म शब्दका अर्थ इसके विपरीत है। आचार्यलोग इष्टकी प्राप्ति करानेवाले धर्मका ही उपदेश करते हैं। अधर्म अनिष्ट-फलदायक होता है , इसलिये आचार्यगण उसका उपदेश नहीं करते। जो वृद्ध, निर्लोभ, आत्मज्ञानी, निष्कपट, अत्यन्त विनम्र तथा मृदुल स्वभाववाले होते हैं, उन्हें आचार्य कहा जाता है। धर्मके ज्ञाता द्विजातियोंद्वारा श्रौत एवं स्मार्त-धर्मका विधान किया गया है। इनमें दारसम्बन्ध (विवाह), अग्निहोत्र और यज्ञ—ये श्रौत-धर्मके लक्षण हैं तथा यम और नियमोंसे युक्त वर्णाश्रमका आचरण स्मार्त-धर्म कहलाता है

verses.hindi: सप्तर्षियोंने पूर्ववर्ती ऋषियोंसे श्रौत-धर्मका ज्ञान प्राप्त करके पुन: उसका उपदेश किया था। ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद और सामवेद—ये ब्रह्माके अङ्ग हैं। व्यतीत हुए मन्वन्तरके धर्मोंका स्मरण करके मनुने उनका उपदेश किया है। इसलिये वर्णाश्रमके विभागानुसार प्रयुक्त हुआ धर्म स्मार्त कहलाता है। इस प्रकार श्रौत एवं स्मार्तरूप द्विविध धर्मको शिष्टाचार कहते हैं। ‘शिष्’ धातुसे निष्ठासंज्ञक ‘क्त’ प्रत्ययका संयोग होनेसे ‘शिष्ट’ शब्द निष्पन्न होता है। प्रत्येक मन्वन्तरमें इस भूतलपर जो धार्मिकलोग वर्तमान रहते हैं, उन्हें शिष्ट कहा जाता है। इस प्रकार लोककी वृद्धि करनेवाले सप्तर्षि और मनु इस भूतलपर धर्मका प्रचार करनेके लिये स्थित रहते हैं, अत: वे शिष्ट शब्दसे अभिहित होते हैं। वे शिष्टगण प्रत्येक युगमें मार्ग-भ्रष्ट हुए धर्मकी पुन: स्थापना करते हैं। इसीलिये शिष्टगण दूसरे मन्वन्तरमें प्रजाओंके वर्णाश्रम-धर्मकी सिद्धिके लिये पुन: वेदत्रयी (ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद, सामवेद), वार्ता (कृषिव्यापार) और दण्डनीतिका आचरण करते हैं। इस प्रकार पूर्वके युगोंमें उपस्थित पूर्वजोंद्वारा अभिमत होनेके कारण यह शिष्टाचार सनातन होता है। दान, सत्य, तपस्या, निर्लोभता, विद्या, यज्ञानुष्ठान, पूजन और इन्द्रियनिग्रह—ये आठ आचरण शिष्टाचारके लक्षण हैं। चूँकि मनु और सप्तर्षि आदि शिष्टगण सभी मन्वन्तरोंमें इस लक्षणके अनुसार आचरण करते हैं, इसलिये इसे शिष्टाचार कहा जाता है। इस प्रकार पूर्वानुक्रमसे श्रवण किये जानेके कारण श्रुतिसम्बन्धी धर्मको श्रौत जानना चाहिये और स्मरण होनेके कारण स्मृति-प्रतिपादित धर्मको स्मार्त कहा जाता है। श्रौतधर्म यज्ञ और वेदस्वरूप है तथा स्मार्तधर्म वर्णाश्रमधर्म-नियामक है
verses.commentary: Sense: three worlds. la the days gone by the sages, the Maruts, and Indra, etc., shivering with fear spoke to liva ** Protect us.** — 1 « 4.
verses.science: अनेकों प्रकारको सैकड़ों शिखाओंसे युक्त प्रज्वलित हो उठे, जिससे जला हुआ वह सम्पूर्ण त्रिपुर पलाशपुष्पके समान लाल रंगका दिखायी पड़ रहा था उस समय धुएँके कारण एक…। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि ब्रह्मणो ऽङ्गानि वै श्रुतिः मन्वन्तरस्यातीतस्य स्मृत्वा तन्मनुरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni brahmaṇo 'ṅgāni vai śrutiḥ manvantarasyātītasya smṛtvā tanmanurabravīt
verses.translation: The Lord said Devas! what is the fear in your mind which has brought you here? whom dot you fear? what are your troubles? Tell me all about yourselves.'* — 5-6.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord said Devas! what is the fear in your mind which has brought you here? whom dot you fear? what are your troubles? Tell me all about yourselves.'* — 5-6.
verses.science: रहा था। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्स्मार्तः सूतो धर्मो वर्णाश्रमविभागशः एवं वै द्विविधो धर्मः शिष्टाचारः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tasmātsmārtaḥ sūto dharmo varṇāśramavibhāgaśaḥ evaṃ vai dvividho dharmaḥ śiṣṭācāraḥ sa ucyate
verses.translation: Risis said: — " 0 Mahftdeva! the most illustrious and valiant demon V&nfisura is the owner of Tripura whicli moves about in the firmament. We have come to seek your protection, being afraid of him. You are our salvation; pray, therefore, rescue us from the oppressions of that demon. Deva! be pleased to do what may be good to the Devas, the Gandharvas and the Risis, etc. — 7-10.
verses.wordMeaning: Risis said: — " 0 Mahftdeva! the most illustrious and valiant demon V&nfisura is the owner of Tripura whicli moves about in the firmament. We have come to seek your protection, being afraid of him. You are our salvation; pray, therefore,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Risis said: — " 0 Mahftdeva! the most illustrious and valiant demon V&nfisura is the owner of Tripura whicli moves about in the firmament. We have come to seek your protection, being afraid of him. You are our salvation; pray, therefore,…
verses.science: हंसों और बतखोंसे परिपूर्ण एवं कमलोंसे युक्त पुष्करिणी, बगीचे तथा बावलियाँ, जो एक योजन लम्बी- चौड़ी और खिले हुए कमलोंसे व्याप्त थीं, अग्निसे जलती हुई दिखायी द…। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिषेर् धातोश्च निष्ठान्ताच् छिष्टशब्दं प्रचक्षते मन्वन्तरेषु ये शिष्टा इह तिष्ठन्ति धार्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: śiṣer dhātośca niṣṭhāntāc chiṣṭaśabdaṃ pracakṣate manvantareṣu ye śiṣṭā iha tiṣṭhanti dhārmikāḥ
verses.translation: iva said: — " Do not be anxious. I shall do everything. You will attain peace ere long.'* — 11.
verses.commentary: Sense: iva said: — " Do not be anxious. I shall do everything. You will attain peace ere long.'* — 11.
verses.science: निर्दयो व्यदहद् वह्लिर्हरक्रोधेन प्रेरितः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मनुः सप्तर्षयश्चैव लोकसंतानकारिणः तिष्ठन्तीह च धर्मार्थं ताञ्छिष्टान्सम्प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: manuḥ saptarṣayaścaiva lokasaṃtānakāriṇaḥ tiṣṭhantīha ca dharmārthaṃ tāñchiṣṭānsampracakṣate
verses.translation: After thus consoling them, the Lord went to the banks of the Nar- madii and began to devise plans for the destruction of that demon. — 12.
verses.commentary: Sense: After thus consoling them, the Lord went to the banks of the Nar- madii and began to devise plans for the destruction of that demon. — 12.
verses.science: काचिच्छ्यामा विशालाक्षी मुक्तावलिविभूषिता काचित् कनकवर्णाभा इन्द्रनीलविभूषिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तैः शिष्टैश्चलितो धर्मः स्थाप्यते वै युगे युगे त्रयी वार्त्ता दण्डनीतिः प्रजावर्णाश्रमेप्सया
verses.transliteration: taiḥ śiṣṭaiścalito dharmaḥ sthāpyate vai yuge yuge trayī vārttā daṇḍanītiḥ prajāvarṇāśramepsayā
verses.translation: He said to himself ''How shall I kill the demon? '* He then thought of the sage Narada who appeared then and there; and said " Mah&deva! what are your behests? Why have you summoned me? 1 shall carry out your commands." — 13-1 4.
verses.commentary: Sense: He said to himself ''How shall I kill the demon? '* He then thought of the sage Narada who appeared then and there; and said " Mah&deva! what are your behests? Why have you summoned me? 1 shall carry out your commands." — 13-1 4.
verses.science: काचिदादित्यसङ्काशा प्रसुप्ता च गृहे स्थिता मेघवर्णापरा नारी हारकेयूरभूषिता काचिच्चन्द्रप्रभा सौम्या वज्रवैडूर्यभूषिता। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिष्टैराचर्यते यस्मात् पुनश्चैव मनुक्षये पूर्वैःपूर्वैर्मतत्वाच्च शिष्टाचारः स शाश्वतः
verses.transliteration: śiṣṭairācaryate yasmāt punaścaiva manukṣaye pūrvaiḥpūrvairmatatvācca śiṣṭācāraḥ sa śāśvataḥ
verses.translation: iiva said: — " Narada! virtuous women reside within the Tripura of VAnasura and by their virtue the Tripura moves about in the space. You should, therefore, go and delude those ladies in Tripura." — 15-17.
verses.commentary: Sense: iiva said: — " Narada! virtuous women reside within the Tripura of VAnasura and by their virtue the Tripura moves about in the space. You should, therefore, go and delude those ladies in Tripura." — 15-17.
verses.science: काचित् कुन्देन्दुवार्णाभा क्रीडन्ती स्वगृहे स्थिता काचित् सुवर्णवर्णाभा नीलरलैर्विभूषिता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दानं सत्यं तपो लोको विद्येज्या पूजनं दमः अष्टौ तानि चरित्राणि शिष्टाचारस्य लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: dānaṃ satyaṃ tapo loko vidyejyā pūjanaṃ damaḥ aṣṭau tāni caritrāṇi śiṣṭācārasya lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Hearing those words of the Lord, the sage went and did what be was directed to fulfil. That Tripura was decorated with various kinds of precious stones, was 100 yojanas broad and 200 yojanas in length. The sage saw Vanasura in such a magnificent place. — 18-19.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hearing those words of the Lord, the sage went and did what be was directed to fulfil. That Tripura was decorated with various kinds of precious stones, was 100 yojanas broad and 200 yojanas in length. The sage saw Vanasura in such a magnificent place. — 18-19.
verses.science: और घोड़ोंमें फैलकर निर्दयतापूर्वक जला रहे थे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: शिष्टा यस्माच्चरन्त्येनं मनुः सप्तर्षयश्च ह मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु शिष्टाचारस्ततः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: śiṣṭā yasmāccarantyenaṃ manuḥ saptarṣayaśca ha manvantareṣu sarveṣu śiṣṭācārastataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The demon king who was seated on a majestic throne with the brilli- ance of the twelve suns, wearing earrings, coronet, garlands and armlets of gold studded witli precious stones; stood up to receive the sage Narada; and said " Devarisi! you have come here of your own accord. I offer you an oblation and water for washing your feet." He then saluted the sage and said " Let me know your commands and I shall carry them out. You have come here after a long time. Pray take your seat." — 20-23.
verses.wordMeaning: The demon king who was seated on a majestic throne with the brilli- ance of the twelve suns, wearing earrings, coronet, garlands and armlets of gold studded witli precious stones; stood up to receive the sage Narada; and said " Devarisi! you have come here of your own accord.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The demon king who was seated on a majestic throne with the brilli- ance of the twelve suns, wearing earrings, coronet, garlands and armlets of gold studded witli precious stones; stood up to receive the sage Narada; and said " Devarisi! you have come here of your own accord.…
verses.science: हुआ देखकर उसीके ऊपर गिर पड़ी। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञेयः श्रवणाच्छ्रौतः स्मरणात्स्मार्त उच्यते इज्यावेदात्मकः श्रौतः स्मार्तो वर्णाश्रमात्मकः प्रत्यङ्गानि प्रवक्ष्यामि धर्मस्येह तु लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: vijñeyaḥ śravaṇācchrautaḥ smaraṇātsmārta ucyate ijyāvedātmakaḥ śrautaḥ smārto varṇāśramātmakaḥ pratyaṅgāni pravakṣyāmi dharmasyeha tu lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Afterwards AnaupamyS queen said: — "Narada* what dharma pleases the Devas? wliich ordinance is most gratifying to them? — 24-25
verses.commentary: Sense: Afterwards AnaupamyS queen said: — "Narada* what dharma pleases the Devas? wliich ordinance is most gratifying to them? — 24-25
verses.science: बच्चेको जलते हुए देखकर मेघके शब्दके समान रोने लगी। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टानुभूतमर्थं च यः पृष्टो न विगूहते यथाभूतप्रवादस्तु इत्येतत्सत्यलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭānubhūtamarthaṃ ca yaḥ pṛṣṭo na vigūhate yathābhūtapravādastu ityetatsatyalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Narada said: — One who gives away a cow and sesamum to a Brah- mana well-versed in the Vedas gets the benefit of having given away lands beyond the seas. He enjoys himself in a Vimfina shining like crores of suns for a considerable period. The lady who gives away after observing a fast the following trees: — Woodapple, roseapple, Kadamba, Ohampaka, Arfoka, Aeiwattha, plantain, banyan, pomegranate, Neein and Maliufl; her breasts take the form of the woodapple, her thighs become like the trunk of the plantain tree. She becomes adorable like the sacred Actwattha tree and sweet smelling like the Neem, illustrious like the Champaka, grietlese like Arfoka, sweet like the Mahud, soft like the leaves of the banyan. She always gets prosperity. The giving of pumpkins and creepers is not considered high, and the husband of a lady who worships the Devas
verses.hindi: अब मैं धर्मके प्रत्येक अङ्गका लक्षण बतला रहा हूँ। देखे तथा अनुभव किये हुए विषयके पूछे जानेपर उसे न छिपाना, अपितु घटित हुएके अनुसार यथार्थ कह देना—यह सत्यका लक्षण है। ब्रह्मचर्य, तपस्या, मौनावलम्बन और निराहार रहना—ये तपस्याके लक्षण हैं, जो अत्यन्त भीषण एवं दुष्कर हैं। जिसमें पशु, द्रव्य, हवि, ऋग्वेद, सामवेद, यजुर्वेद, ऋत्विज् तथा दक्षिणाका संयोग होता है, उसे यज्ञ कहते हैं। जो अपनी ही भाँति समस्त प्राणियोंके प्रति उनके हित तथा मङ्गलके लिये निरन्तर हर्षपूर्वक व्यवहार करता है, उसकी वह श्रेष्ठ क्रिया दया कहलाती है। जो निन्दित होनेपर बदलेमें निन्दककी निन्दा नहीं करता तथा आघात किये जानेपर भी बदलेमें उसपर प्रहार नहीं करता, अपितु मन, वचन और शरीरसे प्रतीकारकी भावनासे रहित हो उसे सहन कर लेता है, उसकी उस क्रियाको क्षमा कहते हैं। स्वामीद्वारा रक्षाके लिये दिये गये तथा घबराहटमें छूटे हुए परकीय धनको न ग्रहण करना निर्लोभ नामसे कहा जाता है। मैथुनके विषयमें सुनने, कहने तथा चिन्तन करनेसे निवृत्त रहना ब्रह्मचर्य है और यही शमका लक्षण है
verses.wordMeaning: Narada said: — One who gives away a cow and sesamum to a Brah- mana well-versed in the Vedas gets the benefit of having given away lands beyond the seas. He enjoys himself in a Vimfina shining like crores of suns for a considerable period.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Narada said: — One who gives away a cow and sesamum to a Brah- mana well-versed in the Vedas gets the benefit of having given away lands beyond the seas. He enjoys himself in a Vimfina shining like crores of suns for a considerable period.…
verses.science: करती हुई अपने घरमें ही सो रही थी, वह घरके जलनेपर अग्निशिखासे पीड़ित हो जाग उठी और सबको जलता हुआ देखकर ' हा! मेरा पुत्र कहाँ चला गया ?' ऐसा कहती हुई जलते हुए…। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्यं तपो मौनं निराहारत्वमेव च इत्येतत्तपसो रूपं सुघोरं तु दुरासदम्
verses.transliteration: brahmacaryaṃ tapo maunaṃ nirāhāratvameva ca ityetattapaso rūpaṃ sughoraṃ tu durāsadam
verses.translation: TllB MATSYA PVRANAM.
verses.commentary: Sense: TllB MATSYA PVRANAM.
verses.science: अन्या गृहीतहस्ता तु सखि दह्यति बालिका भगवन् यदि वैरं ते पुरुषेष्वपकारिषु। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पशूनां द्रव्यहविषाम् ऋक्सामयजुषां तथा ऋत्विजां दक्षिणायाश्च संयोगो यज्ञ उच्यते
verses.transliteration: paśūnāṃ dravyahaviṣām ṛksāmayajuṣāṃ tathā ṛtvijāṃ dakṣiṇāyāśca saṃyogo yajña ucyate
verses.translation: with "Kadamba blossoms discarding the food cooked and uncooked as well as fruits, obseiwing the vow of silence in the evening and worship- ping K§etrap&1a first; remains in happiness. The ladies who keep a fast on A§tami, Chaturthi, Panchaml, liwAdaill, Safi l.rAiiti; undoubtedly go to heaven. They are liberated from the ills of the iron age and Dbarmaraja does not admit such ladies in his town. — 26-37.
verses.wordMeaning: with "Kadamba blossoms discarding the food cooked and uncooked as well as fruits, obseiwing the vow of silence in the evening and worship- ping K§etrap&1a first; remains in happiness. The ladies who keep a fast on A§tami, Chaturthi, Panchaml, liwAdaill, Safi l.rAiiti;…

verses.science: किं त्वया न श्रुतं लोके ह्यवध्याः शत्रुयोषितः न कारुण्यं भयं वापि दाक्षिण्यं न स्त्रियः प्रति। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मवत्सर्वभूतेषु यो हिताय शुभाय च वर्तते सततं हृष्टः क्रिया श्रेष्ठा दया स्मृता
verses.transliteration: ātmavatsarvabhūteṣu yo hitāya śubhāya ca vartate satataṃ hṛṣṭaḥ kriyā śreṣṭhā dayā smṛtā
verses.translation: Anaupamya said:— "It is owing to the virtues performed in tho past that you have graced our home with your august presence and I venture to enquire about other ordinances from jrou. Vindhy&bali the renowned queen of the king Bali is my mother-in-law. She is never pleased with me, and same is the case with my father-in-law. The vicious Kumbbivast is my lord's sister who always treats me with con- tempt. How can I be happy under such circumstances? Fray let me know by what ordinance they would turn friendly to me for which 1 shall remain very grateful to you.''— 38-42.
verses.wordMeaning: Anaupamya said:— "It is owing to the virtues performed in tho past that you have graced our home with your august presence and I venture to enquire about other ordinances from jrou. Vindhy&bali the renowned queen of the king Bali is my mother-in-law.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Anaupamya said:— "It is owing to the virtues performed in tho past that you have graced our home with your august presence and I venture to enquire about other ordinances from jrou. Vindhy&bali the renowned queen of the king Bali is my mother-in-law.…
verses.science: अन्याः क्रोशन्ति संक्रुद्धा बालशोकेन मोहिताः दहते निर्दयो वह्निः संक्रुद्धः पूर्वशत्रुवत्। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: आक्रुष्टो ऽभिहतो यस्तु नाक्रोशेत्प्रहरेदपि अदुष्टो वाङ्मनःकायैस् तितिक्षुः सा क्षमा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: ākruṣṭo 'bhihato yastu nākrośetpraharedapi aduṣṭo vāṅmanaḥkāyais titikṣuḥ sā kṣamā smṛtā
verses.translation: N4rada said: — " By observing the ordinance just explained to you, Pdravatl became so dear to oiva, and similarly Lakmi has become so dear to Viinu, and Sarasvati has become endeared to Brahma and Arundhati to Vasitha. Your lord will also become beholden to you by keeping up the very same ordinance and your father-iu-law and mother-in-law will also be silenced." — 43-45.
verses.wordMeaning: N4rada said: — " By observing the ordinance just explained to you, Pdravatl became so dear to oiva, and similarly Lakmi has become so dear to Viinu, and Sarasvati has become endeared to Brahma and Arundhati to Vasitha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: N4rada said: — " By observing the ordinance just explained to you, Pdravatl became so dear to oiva, and similarly Lakmi has become so dear to Viinu, and Sarasvati has become endeared to Brahma and Arundhati to Vasitha.…
verses.science: स्ववशो नैव युष्माकं विनाशं तु करोम्यहम्। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वामिना रक्ष्यमाणानाम् उत्सृष्टानां च सम्भ्रमे परस्वानाम् अनादानम् अलोभ इति संज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: svāminā rakṣyamāṇānām utsṛṣṭānāṃ ca sambhrame parasvānām anādānam alobha iti saṃjñitam
verses.translation: Hearing such words of Nfirada, that queen determined to observe that ordinance and said; — " Be pleased upon me, 0 sage! 1 shall oITer you presents of gold, jewels, garments, which he pleased to accept. Let Lords Vi§nu and Siva be pleased upon me." — 40-48.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hearing such words of Nfirada, that queen determined to observe that ordinance and said; — " Be pleased upon me, 0 sage! 1 shall oITer you presents of gold, jewels, garments, which he pleased to accept. Let Lords Vi§nu and Siva be pleased upon me." — 40-48.
verses.science: धुएँसे व्याकुल होकर पृथ्वीपर सो गयी। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मैथुनस्यासमाचारो जल्पनाच्चिन्तनात्तथा निवृत्तिर्ब्रह्मचर्यं च तदेतच्छमलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: maithunasyāsamācāro jalpanāccintanāttathā nivṛttirbrahmacaryaṃ ca tadetacchamalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Nfirada said: — " Lady! you should bestow these presents on some Br&hmana who may be poor and in need of support. I am blessed with everything and you ought to show only your devotion to roe." — 49.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nfirada said: — " Lady! you should bestow these presents on some Br&hmana who may be poor and in need of support. I am blessed with everything and you ought to show only your devotion to roe." — 49.
verses.science: शत्रुकी स्त्रियाँ भी अवध्य होती हैं कया जलाना और नाश करना ये ही तुम्हारे गुण हैं ? तुम्हारेमें स्त्रियोंके प्रति दया, भय अथवा उदारता नहीं है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मार्थे वा परार्थे वा इन्द्रियाणीह यस्य वै विषये न प्रवर्तन्ते दमस्यैतत्तु लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: ātmārthe vā parārthe vā indriyāṇīha yasya vai viṣaye na pravartante damasyaitattu lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: In such a way Ntlrada after having softened the minds of all the ladies in Tripura returned to his abode and a breach was thus created in Tripura. — 50-51.
verses.commentary: Sense: In such a way Ntlrada after having softened the minds of all the ladies in Tripura returned to his abode and a breach was thus created in Tripura. — 50-51.
verses.science: निर्दय! तुम क्यों बलपूर्वक रित्रयोंको जला रहे हो ?' इस प्रकार वे रित्रयाँ अनेकों प्रकारसे विलाप करती हुई चीत्कार कर रही थीं? अन्य कुछ स्त्रियाँ बालशोकसे मोहि…। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चात्मके यो विषये कारणे चाष्टलक्षणे न क्रुध्येत प्रतिहतः स जितात्मा भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: pañcātmake yo viṣaye kāraṇe cāṣṭalakṣaṇe na krudhyeta pratihataḥ sa jitātmā bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: IZci'c ends the one hundred and eight) f- seventh ehap,ev on Narmadd vmhdtmya.
verses.hindi: जिसकी इन्द्रियाँ अपने अथवा परायेके हितके लिये विषयोंमें नहीं प्रवृत्त होतीं, यह दमका लक्षण है। जो पाँच कर्मेन्द्रियोंके विषयों तथा आठ प्रकारके कारणोंमें बाधित होनेपर भी क्रोध नहीं करता, वह जितात्मा कहलाता है। जो-जो पदार्थ अपनेको अभीष्ट हों तथा न्यायद्वारा उपार्जित किये गये हों, उन्हें गुणी व्यक्तिको दे देना—यह दानका लक्षण है। जो धर्म श्रुतियों एवं स्मृतियोंद्वारा प्रतिपादित वर्णाश्रमके आचारसे युक्त तथा शिष्टाचारद्वारा परिवर्धित होता है, वही साधु-सम्मत धर्म कहलाता है। अनिष्टके प्राप्त होनेपर उससे द्वेष न करना, इष्टकी प्राप्तिपर उसका अभिनन्दन न करना तथा प्रेम, संताप और विषादसे विशेषतया निवृत्त हो जाना—यह विरक्ति (वैराग्य)-का लक्षण है। किये हुए कर्मोंका न किये गये कर्मोंके साथ त्याग कर देना अर्थात् कृत-अकृत दोनों प्रकारके कर्मोंका त्याग संन्यास कहलाता है तथा कुशल (शुभ) और अकुशल (अशुभ)—दोनोंके परित्यागको न्यास कहते हैं। जिस ज्ञानके प्राप्त होनेपर अव्यक्तसे लेकर विशेषपर्यन्त सभी प्रकारके विकार निवृत्त हो जाते हैं तथा चेतन और अचेतनका ज्ञान हो जाता है, उस ज्ञानसे युक्त प्राणीको ज्ञानी कहते हैं। स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तरमें धर्मतत्त्वके ज्ञाता पूर्वकालीन ऋषियोंने धर्मके प्रत्येक अङ्गका यही लक्षण बतलाया है
verses.commentary: Sense: IZci'c ends the one hundred and eight) f- seventh ehap,ev on Narmadd vmhdtmya.
verses.science: अग्निदेवने कहा-में अपनी इच्छाके अनुसार तुमलोगोंका विनाश नहीं कर रहा हूँ, अपितु मैं आदेशका पालक हूँ। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्यदिष्टतमं द्रव्यं न्यायेनैवागतं च यत् तत्तद्गुणवते देयम् इत्येतद्दानलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ dravyaṃ nyāyenaivāgataṃ ca yat tattadguṇavate deyam ityetaddānalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: M/irakandeya said: — Hear from me, Yudhisthira! what you have asked me to explain. Tho spot on the banks of the NarmadA where the Lord is enshrined is renowned as Mahefivara in all the three worlds and at the very same place lie devised His plans of annihilating Tripura.— 1-2.
verses.commentary: Sense: M/irakandeya said: — Hear from me, Yudhisthira! what you have asked me to explain. Tho spot on the banks of the NarmadA where the Lord is enshrined is renowned as Mahefivara in all the three worlds and at the very same place lie devised His plans of annihilating Tripura.— 1-2.
verses.science: अपरीक्ष्य त्वहं दग्धः शंकरेण महात्मना। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतिस्मृतिभ्यां विहितो धर्मो वर्णाश्रमात्मकः शिष्टाचारप्रवृद्धश्च धर्मो ऽयं साधुसंमतः
verses.transliteration: śrutismṛtibhyāṃ vihito dharmo varṇāśramātmakaḥ śiṣṭācārapravṛddhaśca dharmo 'yaṃ sādhusaṃmataḥ
verses.translation: The Lord seated there lifted up the mount Mandarftchala to serve as His G4ndliva bow. He then put the snake V&suk! in place of the bowstring and Svmikrtika in place of tbe quiver. Vinu in place of the arrow and the fire at the tip of it (the aiTow), Afterwards the wind was made to propel the aiiow. The four Vedaa took the place of the horsea
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord seated there lifted up the mount Mandarftchala to serve as His G4ndliva bow. He then put the snake V&suk! in place of the bowstring and Svmikrtika in place of tbe quiver. Vinu in place of the arrow and the fire at the tip of it (the aiTow),…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord seated there lifted up the mount Mandarftchala to serve as His G4ndliva bow. He then put the snake V&suk! in place of the bowstring and Svmikrtika in place of tbe quiver. Vinu in place of the arrow and the fire at the tip of it (the aiTow),…
verses.science: त्वत्कोपाद् यदि वध्योऽहं तदिदं मा विनश्यतु। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अप्रद्वेषो ह्यनिष्टेषु इष्टं वै नाभिनन्दति प्रीतितापविषादानां विनिवृत्तिर् विरक्तता
verses.transliteration: apradveṣo hyaniṣṭeṣu iṣṭaṃ vai nābhinandati prītitāpaviṣādānāṃ vinivṛttir viraktatā
verses.translation: GUAPTn CLXXXVIII.
verses.commentary: Sense: GUAPTn CLXXXVIII.
verses.science: शिव शंकर शर्व हराय नमो कुसुमायुधदेहविनाशकर प्रमदाप्रिय कान्त विरक्त नमः। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: संन्यासः कर्मणां न्यासः कृतानामकृतैः सह कुशलाकुशलाभ्यां तु प्रहाणं न्यास उच्यते
verses.transliteration: saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaḥ kṛtānāmakṛtaiḥ saha kuśalākuśalābhyāṃ tu prahāṇaṃ nyāsa ucyate
verses.translation: of the chariot. AivintkumSra was employed in place of the reins and Indra in place of the axle. Kuvera formed the banner. — 3-5.
verses.commentary: Sense: of the chariot. AivintkumSra was employed in place of the reins and Indra in place of the axle. Kuvera formed the banner. — 3-5.
verses.science: श्वलचन्द्रकलाङ्कर देव नमः न निवर्तति जन्म न पापमतिः। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तादिविशेषान्तव् इकारे ऽस्मिन्निवर्तते चेतनाचेतनं ज्ञात्वा ज्ञाने ज्ञानी स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: avyaktādiviśeṣāntav ikāre 'sminnivartate cetanācetanaṃ jñātvā jñāne jñānī sa ucyate
verses.translation: Yama put himself to the right-hand of the Lord and K4la to the left. The groups of the Devas and the Gandharvas formed the wheels of the chariot. Brahmd. was the charioteer. In that way, Siva waited for thousands of years after making such preparations. When the three Furas (cities) fell in one line the Lord let out His arrow on Tripura when the inmates of Tripura became helpless and many kinds of destructive omens occurred there. The wooden horses began to neigh and painted ones to wink. All the demons saw themselves dressed in red in course of their dream. One who dreams of things hostile to him becomes void of power and intellect by the glory of the Lord. Then the wind Sfimbar* taka that blows at the close of a cycle commenced. — 6-14.
verses.wordMeaning: Yama put himself to the right-hand of the Lord and K4la to the left. The groups of the Devas and the Gandharvas formed the wheels of the chariot. Brahmd. was the charioteer. In that way, Siva waited for thousands of years after making such preparations.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Yama put himself to the right-hand of the Lord and K4la to the left. The groups of the Devas and the Gandharvas formed the wheels of the chariot. Brahmd. was the charioteer. In that way, Siva waited for thousands of years after making such preparations.…
verses.science: शुचिकर्म निबद्धमपि त्यजति। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यङ्गानि तु धर्मस्य चेत्येतल्लक्षणं स्मृतम् ऋषिभिर्धर्मतत्त्वज्ञैः पूर्वैः स्वायम्भुवे ऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: pratyaṅgāni tu dharmasya cetyetallakṣaṇaṃ smṛtam ṛṣibhirdharmatattvajñaiḥ pūrvaiḥ svāyambhuve 'ntare
verses.translation: It produced fire on account of which the trees of Tripura began to crumble down. There was chaos everywhere. All the gardens were burnt down in an instant. The huge storm devastated the bouses and trees that were on fire which furiously pervaded in all the directions. The dreadful tongues of fire gave a gory appearance to the whole of Tripura. Owing to the dense folds of smoke the demons could not go about from one house to another. The Tripura was thus agitated by the fury of the Lord. Thousands of palaces fell down in all directions and the inmates rushed towards the temples and thousands of demons were reduced to ashes groaning and moaning piteously. Various kinds of VimArjas and picturesque places were consumed by the fearful lire. — 15-24.
verses.wordMeaning: It produced fire on account of which the trees of Tripura began to crumble down. There was chaos everywhere. All the gardens were burnt down in an instant. The huge storm devastated the bouses and trees that were on fire which furiously pervaded in all the directions.…

verses.science: बहुमूल्य रत्नों, स्त्रियों और अन्यान्य अनेक प्रकारके पदार्थोको छोड़कर नगरद्वारसे बाहर निकला। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अत्र वो वर्णयिष्यामि विधिं मन्वन्तरस्य तु तथैव चातुर्होत्रस्य चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य चैव हि
verses.transliteration: atra vo varṇayiṣyāmi vidhiṃ manvantarasya tu tathaiva cāturhotrasya cāturvarṇyasya caiva hi
verses.translation: The pleasure gardens smiling with lotus beds were also burnt down along with the swans and cranes. The lofty palace tops looking like the mountain peaks, adorned with gems and lotuses, fell down on being burnt up, like a heap of clouds. The fire of the Lord's fury burnt down quite unspai'ingly several children, cows, birds, horses, women, and many people sleeping as well as awake. — 25-28.
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasure gardens smiling with lotus beds were also burnt down along with the swans and cranes. The lofty palace tops looking like the mountain peaks, adorned with gems and lotuses, fell down on being burnt up, like a heap of clouds.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasure gardens smiling with lotus beds were also burnt down along with the swans and cranes. The lofty palace tops looking like the mountain peaks, adorned with gems and lotuses, fell down on being burnt up, like a heap of clouds.…
verses.science: यह लिङ्ग विनष्ट न हो। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिमन्वन्तरं चैव श्रुतिरन्या विधीयते ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि यथावत्प्रतिदैवतम्
verses.transliteration: pratimanvantaraṃ caiva śrutiranyā vidhīyate ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni yathāvatpratidaivatam
verses.translation: The nymph like beauties of Tripura fell down burnt with their young ones hugged to their breasts. Some ladies wearing garlands of pearl and gold fell down on the ground consumed by flames and suffocated by smoke. Some beauties seeing their Lord lying on the ground jumped down from the upper storey of their mansion and wore instantly eaten up by the flames. The belaboured demons lying on tho ground got up with their sword but were soon consumed by the raging fire; Some ladies of the cloudy hue wearing garlands and armlets, some fair-coraplexioned beauties giving milk to their dear litle ones were also consumed by fire. Some ladies seeing their children eaten up by the fire sent forth shrilling wails. Some ladies wearing diamond and emerald necklaces and shining like the moon with their children in their lap, fell down on the ground after being charred. Some moon-faced beauties waking up from their sleep found their mansion on fire and began to lament on realizing their children being burnt. Some ladies adorned with golden ornaments fell down on the ground holding their consumed children in their arms. Some fainted away by the fumes of smoke and fell down grasping the hand of their maids. — 29-40.
verses.hindi: अब मैं आपलोगोंसे मन्वन्तरमें होनेवाले चारों वर्णोंके चातुर्होत्रकी विधिका वर्णन कर रहा हूँ। प्रत्येक मन्वन्तरमें विभिन्न प्रकारकी श्रुतिका विधान होता है , किंतु ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद और सामवेद—ये तीनों वेद देवताओंसे संयुक्त रहते हैं। अग्निहोत्रकी विधि तथा स्तोत्र पूर्ववत् चलते रहते हैं। द्रव्यस्तोत्र, गुणस्तोत्र, कर्मस्तोत्र और अभिजनस्तोत्र—ये चार प्रकारके स्तोत्र होते हैं तथा सभी मन्वन्तरोंमें कुछ भेदसहित प्रकट होते हैं। उन्हींसे ब्रह्मस्तोत्रकी बारंबार प्रवृत्ति होती है। इस प्रकार मन्त्रोंके गुणोंकी समुत्पत्ति चार प्रकारकी होती है, जो अथर्व, ऋक्, यजु: और साम—इन चारों वेदोंमें पृथक्-पृथक् प्राप्त होती है। पूर्व मन्वन्तरके आदिमें परम दुष्कर तपस्यामें लगे हुए उन ऋषियोंके अन्त:करणमें ये मन्त्र प्रादुर्भूत होते हैं। ये असंतोष, भय, कष्ट, मोह और शोकरूप पाँच प्रकारके कष्टोंसे ऋषियोंकी रक्षा करते हैं। अब ऋषियोंका जैसा लक्षण, जैसी इच्छा तथा जैसा व्यक्तित्व होता है, उसका लक्षण बतला रहा हूँ। भूतकालीन तथा भविष्यकालीन ऋषियोंमें आर्ष शब्दका प्रयोग पाँच प्रकारसे होता है। अब मैं आर्ष शब्दकी उत्पत्ति बतला रहा हूँ। समस्त महाप्रलयोंके समय जब सारा जगत् घोर अन्धकारसे आच्छादित हो जाता है, उस समय देवताओंका कोई विभाग नहीं रह जाता। तीनों गुण अपनी साम्यावस्थामें स्थित हो जाते हैं, तब जो बिना ज्ञानका सहारा लिये चेतनताको प्रकट करनेके लिये प्रवृत्त होता है, उस चेतनाधिष्ठित ज्ञानयुक्त कर्मको आर्ष कहते हैं। वे मत्स्य और उदककी भाँति आधाराधेयरूपसे प्रवृत्त होते हैं। तब सारा त्रिगुणात्मक जगत् चेतनासे युक्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: The nymph like beauties of Tripura fell down burnt with their young ones hugged to their breasts. Some ladies wearing garlands of pearl and gold fell down on the ground consumed by flames and suffocated by smoke.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The nymph like beauties of Tripura fell down burnt with their young ones hugged to their breasts. Some ladies wearing garlands of pearl and gold fell down on the ground consumed by flames and suffocated by smoke.…
verses.science: विख्यात हूँ। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथैवाभिजनस्तोत्रं स्तोत्रमेवं चतुर्विधम् मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु यथा भेदा भवन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: tathaivābhijanastotraṃ stotramevaṃ caturvidham manvantareṣu sarveṣu yathā bhedā bhavanti hi
verses.translation: Some overcome by the fury of the fire with their hands folded and uplifted began to pray as follows: —
verses.commentary: Sense: Some overcome by the fury of the fire with their hands folded and uplifted began to pray as follows: —
verses.science: अक्षयश्चाव्ययो लोके विचरस्वाकुतोभयः। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवर्तयन्ति तेषां वै ब्रह्मस्तोत्रं पुनः पुनः एवं मन्त्रगुणानां तु समुत्पत्तिश्चतुर्विधा
verses.transliteration: pravartayanti teṣāṃ vai brahmastotraṃ punaḥ punaḥ evaṃ mantraguṇānāṃ tu samutpattiścaturvidhā
verses.translation: " Agni! if thou art angry with male population hostile to thee; what is the fault of the women confined in the bouses like so many domesticat- ed Kokilas pent up in cages? 0 sinner, merciless! why art thou enraged with the women. Thou art devoid of right understanding, shame and heroic virtues and truth. 0 sinner! hast thou not heard commonlj'' said in the world that the women of the enemy should not be killed? To consume is thy attribute but thou hast no mercy and right under- standing* Even a Mlechchha is moved to compassion to see a burning woman. This attribute of consumption is also useless in thee. It is simply thy vice, for what is the good of thy killing women? O sinner, wicked, merciless, miserable wretch Agni! thou art indeed most unfor- tunate. Thou burnest us by force." — 41-48.
verses.wordMeaning: " Agni! if thou art angry with male population hostile to thee; what is the fault of the women confined in the bouses like so many domesticat- ed Kokilas pent up in cages? 0 sinner, merciless! why art thou enraged with the women. Thou art devoid of right understanding,…

verses.science: एवं तु त्रिपुरं दग्धं शंकरेण महात्मना। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथर्वऋग्यजुःसाम्नां वेदेष्विह पृथक्पृथक् ऋषीणां तप्यतां तेषां तपः परमदुश्चरम्
verses.transliteration: atharvaṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ vedeṣviha pṛthakpṛthak ṛṣīṇāṃ tapyatāṃ teṣāṃ tapaḥ paramaduścaram
verses.translation: She was rendered senseless after thus wailing and thinking of her children for a long time. The fire like an old foe of the preciou lives also dried up the wells and the tanks. — 49-50.
verses.commentary: Sense: She was rendered senseless after thus wailing and thinking of her children for a long time. The fire like an old foe of the preciou lives also dried up the wells and the tanks. — 49-50.
verses.science: हाहाकारस्तदा जातो देवासुरकृतो महान् एवं वृत्तं तदा तस्मिन् पर्वतेऽमरकण्टके। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्राः प्रादुर्भवन्त्यादौ पूर्वमन्वन्तरस्य ह असंतोषाद्भयाद्दुःखान् मोहाच्छोकाच्च पञ्चधा
verses.transliteration: mantrāḥ prādurbhavantyādau pūrvamanvantarasya ha asaṃtoṣādbhayādduḥkhān mohācchokācca pañcadhā
verses.translation: "Mlechchha! what will be thy faith after burning us? Hearing such speech of the ladies the Agni said " 1 am not consuming you of my own will. I have been born to cause destruction. I liave no mercy. I make my way everywhere freely througl\ the glory of Siva," Afterwards Vaiuisura also saw Tripura burning. — 5153.

verses.science: वर्षकोटिसहस्त्रं तु त्रिंशत्कोट्यस्तथापराः ततो महीतलं प्राप्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां तारका येन लक्षणेन यदृच्छया ऋषीणां यादृशत्वं हि तद्वक्ष्यामीह लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ tārakā yena lakṣaṇena yadṛcchayā ṛṣīṇāṃ yādṛśatvaṃ hi tadvakṣyāmīha lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: He said from his throne " The wicked Devas of little valour have worked out my ruin which is decidedly due to the glory of iiva. The Lord is consuming me without any examination of the reasons for his action.
verses.commentary: Sense: He said from his throne " The wicked Devas of little valour have worked out my ruin which is decidedly due to the glory of iiva. The Lord is consuming me without any examination of the reasons for his action.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतानागतानां च पञ्चधा ह्यार्षकं स्मृतम् तथा ऋषीणां वक्ष्यामि आर्षस्येह समुद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: atītānāgatānāṃ ca pañcadhā hyārṣakaṃ smṛtam tathā ṛṣīṇāṃ vakṣyāmi ārṣasyeha samudbhavam
verses.translation: No one can kill me without the aid of liva." — 54-55. Saying so the demon king abandoned his sons, friends, &c., and set out of the town with the idol of Siva placed on bis head putting many women and various kinds of jewels in front of the idol. lie stood up on the serial track and after making liis salutations to the Lord of the three worlds said " Deva! 1 have given up this town and you should not kill me. Deva! if you, however, feel disposed to kill me, do not consume this idol of my worship which I have always adored with great devotion. Deva I I have been a slave of Thy feet in every past life and now I offer iny prayer to

verses.sanskrit: गुणसाम्येन वर्तन्ते सर्वसंप्रलये तदा अविभागेन देवानाम् अनिर्देश्ये तमोमये
verses.transliteration: guṇasāmyena vartante sarvasaṃpralaye tadā avibhāgena devānām anirdeśye tamomaye
verses.translation: Thee, composed in these Totaka stanzas. O S5iva, iaukara, arba, Tiara, Bhima, Maherfvara, the Destroyer of Kama, the Annihilator of Tripura, the wielder of the Trident! I salute Tliee. O Pramadapriya, the one saluted by the demons as well as by the Devas, having a most illustrious face wider than that of a horse, a monkey and a lion; I salute Thee. The Devas and the demons cause me pain. Deva! 1 am always engaged in my devotion to Thee. I have not the wealth in shape of sons, wife, horses, &c. I only depend on my attachment to Thee. 1 am greatly oppressed and feel as if I were in hell. My inborn vice does not show signs of decline and my understanding leaves off virtues. The vices can only be abandoned by Thy grace." — 56-66.
verses.wordMeaning: Thee, composed in these Totaka stanzas. O S5iva, iaukara, arba, Tiara, Bhima, Maherfvara, the Destroyer of Kama, the Annihilator of Tripura, the wielder of the Trident! I salute Tliee. O Pramadapriya, the one saluted by the demons as well as by the Devas,…
