verses.transliteration: abuddhipūrvakaṃ tadvai cetanārthaṃ pravartate tenārṣaṃ buddhipūrvaṃ tu cetanenāpyadhiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: One who would recite this prayer will be granted some handsome boon like the one granted to Vanasura by the Lord. — 67. CUAPTEIt CLXXXVIU.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who would recite this prayer will be granted some handsome boon like the one granted to Vanasura by the Lord. — 67. CUAPTEIt CLXXXVIU.
verses.science: जा पहुँचीं। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवर्तते तथा ते तु यथा मत्स्योदकावुभौ चेतनाधिकृतं सर्वं प्रावर्तत गुणात्मकम् कार्यकारणभावेन तथा तस्य प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: pravartate tathā te tu yathā matsyodakāvubhau cetanādhikṛtaṃ sarvaṃ prāvartata guṇātmakam kāryakāraṇabhāvena tathā tasya pravartate
verses.translation: Mah&deva, on hearing the above beautiful prayer said joyfully
verses.commentary: Sense: Mah&deva, on hearing the above beautiful prayer said joyfully
verses.science: महाराज! यह अमरकण्टक पर्वत ऐसा पुण्यजनक है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विषयो विषयित्वं च तदा ह्यर्थपदात्मकौ कालेन प्रापणीयेन भेदाश्च कारणात्मकाः
verses.transliteration: viṣayo viṣayitvaṃ ca tadā hyarthapadātmakau kālena prāpaṇīyena bhedāśca kāraṇātmakāḥ
verses.translation: " Son! Be not afraid. Get into the golden Pura and carry your family and relations with you. VanSsura! you will not be killed 1>y the Devas from now till the time of your doom." The Lord thus again granted such a boon to that demon; and told him to roam about in the world fearlessly and also quenched the raging fire. — 69-71. " For this reason the Lord did not consume his third Pura, which is sailing about the sky by the power of iva. The other two Puras fell down
verses.hindi: उस जगत‍्की प्रवृत्ति कार्य-कारण-भावसे उसी प्रकार होती है, जैसे विषय और विषयित्व तथा अर्थ और पद परस्पर घुले-मिले रहते हैं। प्राप्त हुए कालके अनुसार कारणात्मक भेद उत्पन्न हो जाते हैं। तब क्रमश: महत्तत्त्व आदि प्राकृतिक तत्त्व प्रकट होते हैं। उस महत्तत्त्वसे अहंकार और अहंकारसे भूतेन्द्रियोंकी उत्पत्ति होती है। तत्पश्चात् उन भूतोंसे परस्पर अनेकों प्रकारके भूत उत्पन्न होते हैं। तब प्रकृतिका कारणतुरंत ही कार्य-रूपमें परिणत हो जाता है। जैसे एक ही उल्मुक—मशालसे एक ही साथ अनेकों वृक्षप्रकाशित हो जाते हैं, उसी प्रकार एक ही कारणसे एक ही समय अनेकों क्षेत्रज्ञ—जीव प्रकट हो जाते हैं। जैसे घने अन्धकारमें सहसा जुगनू चमक उठता है, वैसे ही जुगनूकी तरह चमकता हुआ अव्यक्त प्रकट हो जाता है। वह महात्मा अव्यक्त शरीरमें ही स्थित रहता है और महान् अन्धकारको पार करके बड़ी विलक्षणतासे जाना जाता है। वह विद्वान् अव्यक्त अपनी तपस्याके अन्त समयतक वहीं स्थित रहता है, ऐसा सुना जाता है। वृद्धिको प्राप्त होते हुए उस अव्यक्तके हृदयमें चार प्रकारकी बुद्धि प्रादुर्भूत होती है। उन चारोंके नाम हैं—ज्ञान, वैराग्य, ऐश्वर्य और धर्म। उस अव्यक्तके ये प्राकृतिक कर्म अगम्य हैं। महात्मा अव्यक्तके शरीरके चैतन्यसे सिद्धिका प्रादुर्भाव बतलाया जाता है। चूँकि वह पहले-पहल शरीरमें शयन करता है तथा उसे क्षेत्रका ज्ञान प्राप्त रहता है, इसलिये वह शरीरमें शयन करनेसे पुरुष और क्षेत्रका ज्ञान होनेसे क्षेत्रज्ञ कहलाता है। चूँकि वह धर्मसे उत्पन्न होता है, इसलिये उसे धार्मिक भी कहते हैं। प्राकृतिक शरीरमें बुद्धिका संयोग होनेसे वह अव्यक्त चेतन कहलाता है तथा क्षेत्रसे कोई प्रयोजन न होनेपर भी उसे क्षेत्रज्ञ कहा जाता है। निवृत्तिके समय क्षेत्रज्ञ उस अचेतन पुराणपुरुषको जानता है कि यह मेरा भोग्य विषय है
verses.wordMeaning: " Son! Be not afraid. Get into the golden Pura and carry your family and relations with you. VanSsura! you will not be killed 1>y the Devas from now till the time of your doom." The Lord thus again granted such a boon to that demon;…
verses.commentary: Sense: " Son! Be not afraid. Get into the golden Pura and carry your family and relations with you. VanSsura! you will not be killed 1>y the Devas from now till the time of your doom." The Lord thus again granted such a boon to that demon;…
verses.science: जाती हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सांसिद्धिकास्तदा वृत्ताः क्रमेण महदादयः महतो ऽसावहंकारस् तस्माद्भूतेन्द्रियाणि च
verses.transliteration: sāṃsiddhikāstadā vṛttāḥ krameṇa mahadādayaḥ mahato 'sāvahaṃkāras tasmādbhūtendriyāṇi ca
verses.translation: to the ground after being reduced to the ashes. Iriaila mount was formed on the spot whore the first city fell and similarly Araarakantaka sprang up on the spot where the second Pura fell down." — 72-74.
verses.commentary: Sense: to the ground after being reduced to the ashes. Iriaila mount was formed on the spot whore the first city fell and similarly Araarakantaka sprang up on the spot where the second Pura fell down." — 72-74.
verses.science: यत्र संनिहितो देवो देव्या सह महेश्वरः। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: भूतभेदाश्च भूतेभ्यो जज्ञिरे तु परस्परम् संसिद्धिकारणं कार्यं सद्य एव विवर्तते
verses.transliteration: bhūtabhedāśca bhūtebhyo jajñire tu parasparam saṃsiddhikāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ sadya eva vivartate
verses.translation: " RAjendra! On the top of those Puras the groups of Rudras were enshrined. The spot where the burning Pura fell down is marked by the famous Jwfiletlvara. When the tongues of fire flashed into the sky from the btirning city, there was a tremendous uproar among the Devas and the demons when the Tjord took down His arrow from His bow. All this happened on the Mount Amarakantaka. — 75-77. Consequently, the people observing fasts, &c., are born as sole mo- narchs in this world after a period of 30 crores and a thousand years when they have enjoyed the pleasures of the fourteen worlds." — 78-79.
verses.wordMeaning: " RAjendra! On the top of those Puras the groups of Rudras were enshrined. The spot where the burning Pura fell down is marked by the famous Jwfiletlvara. When the tongues of fire flashed into the sky from the btirning city,…
verses.commentary: Sense: " RAjendra! On the top of those Puras the groups of Rudras were enshrined. The spot where the burning Pura fell down is marked by the famous Jwfiletlvara. When the tongues of fire flashed into the sky from the btirning city,…
verses.science: प्रदक्षिणं तु यः कुर्यात् पर्वतेऽमरकण्टके। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथोल्मुकात्तु विटपा एककालाद्भवन्ति हि तथा प्रवृत्ताः क्षेत्रज्ञाः कालेनैकेन कारणात्
verses.transliteration: yatholmukāttu viṭapā ekakālādbhavanti hi tathā pravṛttāḥ kṣetrajñāḥ kālenaikena kāraṇāt
verses.translation: O King Yudhithira! in this way the sacred place Amarakanfaka is the most sanctified and therefore one who goes there on the occasion of a solar or a lunar eclipse and gets tlie merits ten times more than that of the Avamedha sacrifice. One attains heaven by worshipping Maheifvara there. The sin of killing a Brahmana is driven away by going there on the occasion of a solar eclipse. This is the glory of the sacred Mount Amarakantaka. — 80-82.
verses.wordMeaning: O King Yudhithira! in this way the sacred place Amarakanfaka is the most sanctified and therefore one who goes there on the occasion of a solar or a lunar eclipse and gets tlie merits ten times more than that of the Avamedha sacrifice.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O King Yudhithira! in this way the sacred place Amarakanfaka is the most sanctified and therefore one who goes there on the occasion of a solar or a lunar eclipse and gets tlie merits ten times more than that of the Avamedha sacrifice.…
verses.science: अकामो वा सकामो वा नर्मदायां शुभे जले। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथान्धकारे खद्योतः सहसा सम्प्रदृश्यते तथा निवृत्तो ह्यव्यक्तः खद्योत इव संज्वलन्
verses.transliteration: yathāndhakāre khadyotaḥ sahasā sampradṛśyate tathā nivṛtto hyavyaktaḥ khadyota iva saṃjvalan
verses.translation: One who thinks of this Mount Amarakantaka with devotion undoubtedly gets the benefit of a hundred Chandrayaa ordinances. — 83. Amarakantaka is renowned in all the three worlds. It is adorned by the Siddhas, the Gandharvas, &c. — 84.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who thinks of this Mount Amarakantaka with devotion undoubtedly gets the benefit of a hundred Chandrayaa ordinances. — 83. Amarakantaka is renowned in all the three worlds. It is adorned by the Siddhas, the Gandharvas, &c. — 84.
verses.science: गन्धर्वोसे सेवित, विविध वृक्षों और लताओंसे व्याप्त तथा अनेक प्रकारके पुष्पोंसे सुशोभित है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स महात्मा शरीरस्थस् तत्रैवेह प्रवर्तते महतस्तमसः पारे वैलक्षण्याद्विभाव्यते
verses.transliteration: sa mahātmā śarīrasthas tatraiveha pravartate mahatastamasaḥ pāre vailakṣaṇyādvibhāvyate
verses.translation: It abounds with various kinds of flowers, creepers, deer, Siddhas and
verses.commentary: Sense: It abounds with various kinds of flowers, creepers, deer, Siddhas and
verses.science: महाराज! चन्द्रग्रहण और सूर्यग्रहणके अवसरपर जो व्यक्ति ज्चालेश्वरमें प्राणोंका परित्याग करता है, उसे जो फल प्राप्त होता है, उसे सुनिये। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव संस्थितो विद्वांस् तपसो ऽन्त इति श्रुतम् बुद्धिर्विवर्धतस्तस्य प्रादुर्भूता चतुर्विधा
verses.transliteration: tatraiva saṃsthito vidvāṃs tapaso 'nta iti śrutam buddhirvivardhatastasya prādurbhūtā caturvidhā
verses.translation: the Lord iva is enshrined there in pompany of His noble consort Paravati. It is pervaded by BrahmA., Visnu, Indra, Vidyadhara, Risis, Kinnaras, and Yaksas. The serpent Vdsuki loiters there. One who circumambulates that sacred Amarakaptaka gets the benefit of the Pundarika sacrifice. — 85-88. The Lord JwAletfvara is also adored by the Siddhas there. People dying there after bathing in the sacred waters attain heaven. King Yudhiip(hira, hear the benefits attained by those who die there on the occasion of an eclipse — solar or lunar. — 89-90.
verses.wordMeaning: the Lord iva is enshrined there in pompany of His noble consort Paravati. It is pervaded by BrahmA., Visnu, Indra, Vidyadhara, Risis, Kinnaras, and Yaksas. The serpent Vdsuki loiters there.…
verses.commentary: Sense: the Lord iva is enshrined there in pompany of His noble consort Paravati. It is pervaded by BrahmA., Visnu, Indra, Vidyadhara, Risis, Kinnaras, and Yaksas. The serpent Vdsuki loiters there.…
verses.science: जलमें स्नान करता है, वह सभी पापोंसे छुटकारा पा लेता है और रुद्रलोकको प्राप्त करता है इति श्रीमत्स्ये महापुराणे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये अष्टाशीत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः इस…। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं धर्मश्चेति चतुष्टयम् सांसिद्धिकान्यथैतानि अप्रतीतानि तस्य वै
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ dharmaśceti catuṣṭayam sāṃsiddhikānyathaitāni apratītāni tasya vai
verses.translation: Such blessed one after being liberated from all actions and endowed with supreme intellect go and reside in the region of Rudra till the end of the cycle. — 91.
verses.commentary: Sense: Such blessed one after being liberated from all actions and endowed with supreme intellect go and reside in the region of Rudra till the end of the cycle. — 91.
verses.science: नर्मदा-कावेरी-संगमका माहात्म्य पृच्छन्ति ते महात्मानो मार्कण्डेयं महामुनिम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महात्मनः शरीरस्य चैतन्यात्सिद्धिरुच्यते पुरि शेते यतः पूर्वं क्षेत्रज्ञानं तथापि च
verses.transliteration: mahātmanaḥ śarīrasya caitanyātsiddhirucyate puri śete yataḥ pūrvaṃ kṣetrajñānaṃ tathāpi ca
verses.translation: Tm MATBYA WBltHAU. Otores of Riis practise asceticism on the either side of Amareilvara. This Mount Amarakan(aka is one yojana in extent all round. Those who bathe in the sacred Narmadi with or without an object in view, are liberated from all their sins and go to the realm of Rudra. — 92-94.
verses.wordMeaning: Tm MATBYA WBltHAU. Otores of Riis practise asceticism on the either side of Amareilvara. This Mount Amarakan(aka is one yojana in extent all round. Those who bathe in the sacred Narmadi with or without an object in view,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Tm MATBYA WBltHAU. Otores of Riis practise asceticism on the either side of Amareilvara. This Mount Amarakan(aka is one yojana in extent all round. Those who bathe in the sacred Narmadi with or without an object in view,…
verses.science: आख्याहि भगवंस्तथ्यं कावेरीसंगमो महान्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरे शयनात्पुरुषो ज्ञानात्क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते यस्माद्धर्मात्प्रसूते हि तस्माद्वै धार्मिकस्तु सः
verses.transliteration: pure śayanātpuruṣo jñānātkṣetrajña ucyate yasmāddharmātprasūte hi tasmādvai dhārmikastu saḥ
verses.translation: Here ends the one hundred and eighty-eighth cdiapter on ihe Varmadd mdhdtmya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here ends the one hundred and eighty-eighth cdiapter on ihe Varmadd mdhdtmya.
verses.science: शृण्वन्त्ववहिताः सर्वे युधिष्टठिरपुरोगमाः। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सांसिद्धिके शरीरे च बुद्ध्याव्यक्तस्तु चेतनः एवं विवृत्तः क्षेत्रज्ञः क्षेत्रं ह्यनभिसंधितः
verses.transliteration: sāṃsiddhike śarīre ca buddhyāvyaktastu cetanaḥ evaṃ vivṛttaḥ kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetraṃ hyanabhisaṃdhitaḥ
verses.translation: Sflta said: — The king Yudhifthira along with the Risis asked MSrakan- deya. " BhagvS,na! be pleased to relate to us about the junction of the sacred Kaverl. We are desirous of hearing from you the account of the sacred E.4veri by bathing into which the vilest of sinners get emancipation." — 2-3. Mdrakandeya said: — 0 Yudhisthira and 0 Risis! hear with attention that even the illustrious Knvera the Lord of the Ya'<?as got his position by oblations in the sacred Kilveri. Now hear from me how he acquired ail his glory.— 4-5.
verses.wordMeaning: Sflta said: — The king Yudhifthira along with the Risis asked MSrakan- deya. " BhagvS,na! be pleased to relate to us about the junction of the sacred Kaverl.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sflta said: — The king Yudhifthira along with the Risis asked MSrakan- deya. " BhagvS,na! be pleased to relate to us about the junction of the sacred Kaverl.…
verses.science: कावेरी नर्मदा यत्र सङ्गमो लोकविश्रुतः। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्तिसमकाले तु पुराणं तदचेतनम् क्षेत्रज्ञेन परिज्ञातं भोग्यो ऽयं विषयो मम
verses.transliteration: nivṛttisamakāle tu purāṇaṃ tadacetanam kṣetrajñena parijñātaṃ bhogyo 'yaṃ viṣayo mama
verses.translation: At the confluence of the Kfiverl and the NarmadA, Kuvera practised asceticism after bathing in the sacred waters, for a divine century when the Lord fiva on being pleased with him said " Kuvera! ask for what you wish." — 6-8.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the confluence of the Kfiverl and the NarmadA, Kuvera practised asceticism after bathing in the sacred waters, for a divine century when the Lord fiva on being pleased with him said " Kuvera! ask for what you wish." — 6-8.
verses.science: यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव यदि देयो वरो मम। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिर्हिंसागतौ धातुर् विद्या सत्यं तपः श्रुतम् एष सन्निलयो यस्माद् ब्राह्मणस्तुततस् त्व् ऋषिः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣirhiṃsāgatau dhātur vidyā satyaṃ tapaḥ śrutam eṣa sannilayo yasmād brāhmaṇastutatas tv ṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: Kuvera said: — " Devadeva! if you are pleased to grant me a boon, I wish to become the king of the YaLsas." — 0. Hearing those words of Kuvera, the Lord said " Bo it so " and vanished then and there. — 10.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kuvera said: — " Devadeva! if you are pleased to grant me a boon, I wish to become the king of the YaLsas." — 0. Hearing those words of Kuvera, the Lord said " Bo it so " and vanished then and there. — 10.
verses.science: कावेरीसङ्गमं तत्र सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्तिसमकालाच्च बुद्ध्याव्यक्त ऋषिस्त्वयम् ऋषते परमं यस्मात् परमर्षिस्ततः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: nivṛttisamakālācca buddhyāvyakta ṛṣistvayam ṛṣate paramaṃ yasmāt paramarṣistataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Afterwards Kuvera by virtue of that boon became the liord of the Yaksas. — 11.
verses.hindi: ‘ऋषि’ धातुका हिंसा और गति-अर्थमें प्रयोग होता है। इसीसे ‘ऋषि’ शब्द निष्पन्न हुआ है। चूँकि उसे ब्रह्मासे विद्या, सत्य, तप, शास्त्र-ज्ञान आदि समूहोंकी प्राप्ति होती है, इसलिये उसे ऋषि कहते हैं। यह अव्यक्त ऋषि निवृत्तिके समय जब बुद्धि-बलसे परमपदको प्राप्त कर लेता है, तब वह परमर्षि कहलाता है। गत्यर्थक 184 ‘ऋषी’ धातुसे ऋषिनामकी निष्पत्ति होती है तथा वह स्वयं उत्पन्न होता है, इसलिये उसकी ऋषिता मानी गयी है। ब्रह्माके मानस पुत्र ऐश्वर्यशाली वे ऋषि स्वयं उत्पन्न हुए हैं। निवृत्तिमार्गमें लगे हुए वे ऋषि बुद्धिबलसे परम महान् पुरुषको प्राप्त कर लेते हैं। चूँकि वे ऋषि महान् पुरुषत्वसे युक्त रहते हैं, इसलिये महर्षि कहे जाते हैं। उन ऐश्वर्यशाली महर्षियोंको जो मानस एवं औरस पुत्र हुए, वे ऋषिपरक होनेके कारण प्राणियोंमें सर्वप्रथम ऋषि कहलाये। मैथुनद्वारा गर्भसे उत्पन्न हुए ऋषि-पुत्रोंको ऋषीक कहा जाता है। चूँकि ये जीवोंको ब्रह्मपरक बनाते हैं, इसलिये इन्हें ऋषिक कहा जाता है। ऋषिकके पुत्रोंको ऋषि-पुत्र जानना चाहिये। वे दूसरेसे ऋषिधर्मको सुनकर ज्ञानसम्पन्न होते हैं, इसलिये श्रुतर्षि कहलाते हैं। उनका वह ज्ञान अव्यक्तात्मा, महात्मा, अहंकारात्मा, भूतात्मा और इन्द्रियात्मा कहलाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Afterwards Kuvera by virtue of that boon became the liord of the Yaksas. — 11.
verses.science: बतानेको कृपा करें मार्कण्डेयजीने कहा--युधिष्ठिरसहित ऋषिगण! आपलोग सावधान होकर सुनिये। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गत्यर्थाद् ऋषतेर् धातोर् नामनिर्वृत्तिकारणम् यस्मादेष स्वयंभूतस् तस्माच्च ऋषिता मता
verses.transliteration: gatyarthād ṛṣater dhātor nāmanirvṛttikāraṇam yasmādeṣa svayaṃbhūtas tasmācca ṛṣitā matā
verses.translation: Such is the glory of the confluence of the sacred Kslveri with the Narmada. It is the dispeller of all sins. Those wlio do not know about it are undoubtedly deluded. One should, thernfore, bathe there according to the prescribed rites. Both the sacred Kaveri and the Narmada are the most sacred. One who worships oiva after bathing there begets the benefit of Alvaraedha sacrifice and goes to the realm of Rudra. One who is burnt there or keeps up a fast there, gets access everywhere. Mahd.deva has said that such a person after getting access everywhere enjoys the company of beautiful ladies in Rudraloka for 600060000 years. Afterwards he is born as a most illustrious king. One who driuks the water of the Kaverl and the Narmada gets tlie benefit of Chandrayana. He gets the benefit of havdng bathed in the confluence of the Ganges and the Yamunk and attains heaven. King! such is the glory of the junction of the Kfi.veri und the Narmada where, to bathe and perform charities is to dispel all ills and sins." — 12-20. Here ends the one hundred and eighty-ninth chapter on the Harmadd mdhdtmya.
verses.wordMeaning: Such is the glory of the confluence of the sacred Kslveri with the Narmada. It is the dispeller of all sins. Those wlio do not know about it are undoubtedly deluded. One should, thernfore, bathe there according to the prescribed rites.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Such is the glory of the confluence of the sacred Kslveri with the Narmada. It is the dispeller of all sins. Those wlio do not know about it are undoubtedly deluded. One should, thernfore, bathe there according to the prescribed rites.…
verses.science: वर्णन कर रहा हूँ, सुनिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सेश्वराः स्वयमुद्भूता ब्रह्मणो मानसाः सुताः निवर्तमानैस्तैर्बुद्ध्या महान्परिगतः परः
verses.transliteration: seśvarāḥ svayamudbhūtā brahmaṇo mānasāḥ sutāḥ nivartamānaistairbuddhyā mahānparigataḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: OEAFFER OKC.
verses.commentary: Sense: OEAFFER OKC.
verses.science: वे देवाधिदेव वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद् दृशपरत्वेन सह तस्मान्महर्षयः ईश्वराणां सुतास्तेषां मानसाश्चौरसाश्च वै
verses.transliteration: yasmād dṛśaparatvena saha tasmānmaharṣayaḥ īśvarāṇāṃ sutāsteṣāṃ mānasāścaurasāśca vai
verses.translation: M&rakaoya said: — To the north of the NarmadA there is the sacred Mantreirara extending to one yojana. One who bathes there goes to heaven and remains with the Devas for 5000 years. The sacred GarjanA is quite close to it which has originated from the clouds. By virtue of the same the son of RAvaa was named Indrajlta. Here it is the MeghanAda-tlrtha by going where MeghanAda attained great glory. — 1-4. Further on is AmrAtaka by bathing where one gets the benefit of having given away a thousand cows. — 5.
verses.wordMeaning: M&rakaoya said: — To the north of the NarmadA there is the sacred Mantreirara extending to one yojana. One who bathes there goes to heaven and remains with the Devas for 5000 years. The sacred GarjanA is quite close to it which has originated from the clouds.…
verses.commentary: Sense: M&rakaoya said: — To the north of the NarmadA there is the sacred Mantreirara extending to one yojana. One who bathes there goes to heaven and remains with the Devas for 5000 years. The sacred GarjanA is quite close to it which has originated from the clouds.…
verses.science: ७९२ मत्स्यपुराण तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्र स्नायीत मानव:। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिस्तस्मात्परत्वेन भूतादिरृषयस्ततः ऋषिपुत्रा ऋषीकास्तु मैथुनाद्गर्भसम्भवाः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣistasmātparatvena bhūtādirṛṣayastataḥ ṛṣiputrā ṛṣīkāstu maithunādgarbhasambhavāḥ
verses.translation: To the north of the NarmadA is Vitfruta. By bathing there and offering libation to the manes and the Devas one gets his desires fulfilled. Afterwards the devotee should go to the BrahmSvarta-tIrtha. — 6-7.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of the NarmadA is Vitfruta. By bathing there and offering libation to the manes and the Devas one gets his desires fulfilled. Afterwards the devotee should go to the BrahmSvarta-tIrtha. — 6-7.
verses.science: जो मनुष्य वृषभध्वज शिवकी पूजा करता है, वह अश्वमेधफलं प्राप्य रुद्रलोके महीयते॥ १४ अश्वमेध-यज्ञका फल प्राप्त करके रुद्रलोकमें पूजित अग्निप्रवेशं यः कुर्याद् य…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परत्वेन ऋषन्ते वै भूतादीनृषिकास्ततः ऋषिकाणां सुता ये तु विज्ञेया ऋषिपुत्रकाः
verses.transliteration: paratvena ṛṣante vai bhūtādīnṛṣikāstataḥ ṛṣikāṇāṃ sutā ye tu vijñeyā ṛṣiputrakāḥ
verses.translation: BrahmA resides at BrahmAvarta-tlrtha almost every day. By bathing in it one goes to the realm of BrahmA. — 8. Then an advance should be made to the sacred AgAredvara after observing the prescribed ordinances. By going there one attains Budra- loka after being liberated from all bis sins. — 9.
verses.wordMeaning: BrahmA resides at BrahmAvarta-tlrtha almost every day. By bathing in it one goes to the realm of BrahmA. — 8. Then an advance should be made to the sacred AgAredvara after observing the prescribed ordinances.…
verses.commentary: Sense: BrahmA resides at BrahmAvarta-tlrtha almost every day. By bathing in it one goes to the realm of BrahmA. — 8. Then an advance should be made to the sacred AgAredvara after observing the prescribed ordinances.…
verses.science: प्राप्त होती है-एऐसा शंकरजीने मुझे बतलाया था। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा ऋषं परत्वेन श्रुतास्तस्माच्छ्रुतर्षयः अव्यक्तात्मा महात्मा वा-हंकारात्मा तथैव च
verses.transliteration: śrutvā ṛṣaṃ paratvena śrutāstasmācchrutarṣayaḥ avyaktātmā mahātmā vā-haṃkārātmā tathaiva ca
verses.translation: KapilA-tirtha should be visited afterwards. By bathing in it the devotee gets the benefit of having given away a milch cow in charity. — 10.
verses.commentary: Sense: KapilA-tirtha should be visited afterwards. By bathing in it the devotee gets the benefit of having given away a milch cow in charity. — 10.
verses.science: भोगवान् दानशीलश्च महाकुलसमुदभवः। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भूतात्मा चेन्द्रियात्मा च तेषां तज्ज्ञानमुच्यते इत्येवमृषिजातिस्तु पञ्चधा नामविश्रुता
verses.transliteration: bhūtātmā cendriyātmā ca teṣāṃ tajjñānamucyate ityevamṛṣijātistu pañcadhā nāmaviśrutā
verses.translation: One who goes to the sacred Karanja and bathes there attains the Goloka.— 11. Then the devotee should proceed to Kunderfvara where MahAdeva is in residence with Purvatl.— 12.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who goes to the sacred Karanja and bathes there attains the Goloka.— 11. Then the devotee should proceed to Kunderfvara where MahAdeva is in residence with Purvatl.— 12.
verses.science: गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये यत्फलं प्राप्नुयान्नरः। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भृगुर्मरीचिरत्रिश्च अङ्गिराः पुलहः क्रतुः मनुर्दक्षो वसिष्ठश्च पुलस्त्यश्चापि ते दश
verses.transliteration: bhṛgurmarīciratriśca aṅgirāḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ manurdakṣo vasiṣṭhaśca pulastyaścāpi te daśa
verses.translation: One who bathes there is invulnerable even by the Devas. The picturesque Yimaletlvara should then be visited where the Lord has consecrated the DevatfilA. Dying there one attains the realm of Budra. — 13-15.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार ऋषिजाति पाँच प्रकारसे विख्यात है। भृगु, मरीचि, अत्रि, अङ्गिरा, पुलह, क्रतु, मनु, दक्ष, वसिष्ठ और पुलस्त्य—ये दस ऐश्वर्यशाली ऋषि ब्रह्माके मानस पुत्र हैं और स्वयं उत्पन्न हुए हैं। ये ऋषिगण ब्रह्म-परत्वसे युक्त हैं, इसलिये महर्षि माने गये हैं। अब इन ऐश्वर्यशाली महर्षियोंके पुत्ररूप जो ऋषि हैं, उन्हें सुनिये। काव्य (शुक्राचार्य), बृहस्पति, कश्यप, च्यवन, उतथ्य, वामदेव, अगस्त्य, कौशिक, कर्दम, बालखिल्य, विश्रवा और शक्तिवर्धन—ये सभी ऋषि कहलाते हैं, जो अपने तपोबलसे ऋषिताको प्राप्त हुए हैं। अब इन ऋषियोंद्वारा गर्भसे उत्पन्न हुए ऋषीक नामक पुत्रोंको सुनिये। वत्सर, नग्नहू, पराक्रमी भरद्वाज, दीर्घतमा, बृहद्वक्षा, शरद्वान्, वाजिश्रवा, सुचिन्त, शाव, पराशर, शृङ्गी, शङ्खपाद् और राजा वैश्रवण—ये सभी ऋषीक हैं और सत्यके प्रभावसे ऋषिताको प्राप्त हुए हैं। इस प्रकार जो ईश्वर (परमर्षि एवं महर्षि), ऋषि और ऋषीक नामसे विख्यात हैं, उनका वर्णन किया गया
verses.commentary: Sense: One who bathes there is invulnerable even by the Devas. The picturesque Yimaletlvara should then be visited where the Lord has consecrated the DevatfilA. Dying there one attains the realm of Budra. — 13-15.
verses.science: नर्मदाके तटवर्ती तीर्थ HE चात मार्कण्डेयजीने कहा--राजन्! नर्मदाके उत्तर तटपर नार्मदे चोत्तरे कूले तीर्थ योजनविस्तृतम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो मानसा ह्येते उत्पन्नाः स्वयमीश्वराः परत्वेनर्षयो यस्मान् मतास्तस्मान्महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo mānasā hyete utpannāḥ svayamīśvarāḥ paratvenarṣayo yasmān matāstasmānmaharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: Then he should go to the river Puekarin! by bathing into which the devotee becomes entitled to take his seat on the throne of Indra by his side. — 16. It is for these reasons that the sacred NarmadA coming out from the Lord liva is the best of all the streams and the giver of bliss to the animate and the inanimate world. This NarmadA has been described to be the most sacred by Siva the Lord of all the Devas before the Bisis. This river is adorable by all the Devas and is the dispeller of all sins and is venerated by the Devas, the Gandbarvas and the nymphs. 1 make my salutations to the sacred and peace-giving NarmadA that falls into the sea. — 17-21.
verses.wordMeaning: Then he should go to the river Puekarin! by bathing into which the devotee becomes entitled to take his seat on the throne of Indra by his side. — 16.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he should go to the river Puekarin! by bathing into which the devotee becomes entitled to take his seat on the throne of Indra by his side. — 16.…
verses.science: पञ्ज वर्षसहस्राणि क्रीडते कामरूपधृक् ॥ २ , पारणकर पाँच हजार वर्षोतक वहाँ क्रीड़ा करता है। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

The Vaiilys becomes wealthy and the ifidra attains bliss. One anxious for wealth gets pelf. The sacred NarmadA is daily resorted to by the Lord Siva in consequence of which it is the most sacred and dispeller of all sins. — 23-25. verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार अब सभी मन्त्रकर्ता ऋषियोंका नाम पूर्णतया सुनिये। भृगु , काश्यप, प्रचेता, दधीचि, आत्मवान्, ऊर्व, जमदग्नि, वेद, सारस्वत, आर्ष्टिषेण, च्यवन, वीतिहव्य, वेधा, वैण्य, पृथु, दिवोदास, ब्रह्मवान्, गृत्स और शौनक—ये उन्नीस भृगुवंशी ऋषि मन्त्रकर्ताओंमें श्रेष्ठ हैं। अङ्गिरा, त्रित, भरद्वाज, लक्ष्मण, कृतवाच, गर्ग, स्मृति, संकृति, गुरुवीत, मान्धाता, अम्बरीष, युवनाश्व, पुरुकुत्स, स्वश्रव, सदस्यवान्, अजमीढ, अस्वहार्य, उत्कल, कवि, पृषदश्व, विरूप, काव्य, मुद्गल, उतथ्य, शरद्वान्, वाजिश्रवा, अपस्यौष, सुचित्ति, वामदेव, ऋषिज, बृहच्छुक्ल, दीर्घतमा और कक्षीवान्—ये तैंतीस श्रेष्ठ ऋषि अङ्गिरागोत्रीय कहे जाते हैं। ये सभी मन्त्रकर्ता हैं। अब कश्यपवंशमें उत्पन्न होनेवाले ऋषियोंके नाम सुनिये। कश्यप, सहवत्सार, नैध्रुव, नित्य, असित और देवल—ये छ: ब्रह्मवादी ऋषि हैं। अत्रि, अर्धस्वन, शावास्य, गविष्ठिर, सिद्धर्षि कर्णक और पूर्वातिथि—ये छ: मन्त्रकर्ता महर्षि अत्रिवंशोत्पन्न कहे गये हैं। वसिष्ठ, शक्ति, तीसरे पराशर, इन्द्रप्रमित, पाँचवें भरद्वसु, छठे मित्रावरुण तथा सातवें कुण्डिन—इन सात ब्रह्मवादी ऋषियोंको वसिष्ठवंशोत्पन्न जानना चाहिये
verses.wordMeaning: On the thirteenth day of a fortnight the devotee attains the benefits of all the sacrifices by bathing at the Bahunetra-tirtha. — 14. After that the beautiful Agastcsvara-tirtha should be visited. By bathing there one goes to the region of Brahtnii.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the thirteenth day of a fortnight the devotee attains the benefits of all the sacrifices by bathing at the Bahunetra-tirtha. — 14. After that the beautiful Agastcsvara-tirtha should be visited. By bathing there one goes to the region of Brahtnii.…

verses.science: इति श्रीमत्स्ये महापुराणे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये नवत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः इस प्रकार श्रीमत्स्यमहापुराणके नर्मदामाहात्म्यवर्णन-प्रसङ्गमें एक सौ नब्बेवाँ अध्याय सम्पूर्ण…। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एते मन्त्रकृतः सर्वे काश्यपांस्तु निबोधत काश्यपः सहवत्सारो नैध्रुवो नित्य एव च
verses.transliteration: ete mantrakṛtaḥ sarve kāśyapāṃstu nibodhata kāśyapaḥ sahavatsāro naidhruvo nitya eva ca
verses.translation: Afterwards the devotee should go and adore the moon at Soma-tirtha. By bathing there with devotion one gets divine form and remains in bliss for a considerable length of time like iva and enjoys life in the realm of Rudra for 60000 years. Later on a visit shonid be paid to the Lord Pingalevara where by observing a fast for 24 hours one derives the benefit of having observed it for three nights. One who gives away a milch cow in charity goes and enjoj in the realm of Rudra for as many years as there are hair on the body of that cow. One who dies there remains iu the realm of Rudra till the existence of the Sun and the Moon. Those residing on the banks of the Narmadd. remain in heaven like the pious. The devotee should also visit the shrines of Sureilvara and Karkotaketlvara. — 29-35.
verses.wordMeaning: Afterwards the devotee should go and adore the moon at Soma-tirtha. By bathing there with devotion one gets divine form and remains in bliss for a considerable length of time like iva and enjoys life in the realm of Rudra for 60000 years.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Afterwards the devotee should go and adore the moon at Soma-tirtha. By bathing there with devotion one gets divine form and remains in bliss for a considerable length of time like iva and enjoys life in the realm of Rudra for 60000 years.…
verses.science: तदाप्रभृति ब्रह्माद्या ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: असितो देवलश्चैव षडेते ब्रह्मवादिनः अत्रिर् अर्धस्वनश्चैव शावास्यो ऽथ गविष्ठिरः
verses.transliteration: asito devalaścaiva ṣaḍete brahmavādinaḥ atrir ardhasvanaścaiva śāvāsyo 'tha gaviṣṭhiraḥ
verses.translation: There, undoubtedly the sacred Ganges appears on an auspicious day. By bathing at the Nandt-tirtha, the Lord Nandfia becomes pleased with the devotee and he ascends to the world of the Moon. Lord Dipe- livara should be visited next where there is the tirtha of Vedavy&sa in a beautiful forest. In the days gone by, the sacred NarmadS for fear of the sage Vyfisa flowed in the opposite direction and her course was turned to the south only when the sage forced her with a roaring cry. — 36-38. One who circumambulates that sacred place remains in the region of Siva till the existence of the Sun and the Moon. — .
verses.wordMeaning: There, undoubtedly the sacred Ganges appears on an auspicious day. By bathing at the Nandt-tirtha, the Lord Nandfia becomes pleased with the devotee and he ascends to the world of the Moon.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There, undoubtedly the sacred Ganges appears on an auspicious day. By bathing at the Nandt-tirtha, the Lord Nandfia becomes pleased with the devotee and he ascends to the world of the Moon.…
verses.science: तत्र पुण्यं समाख्याहि यथावन्मुनिसत्तम तत्र स्नात्वार्चयेद् देवं गोसहस्त्रफलं लभेत् त्रिरात्रं कारयेद् यस्तु तस्मिस्तीर्थ नराधिप। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्णकश्च ऋषिः सिद्धस् तथा पूर्वातिथिश्च यः
verses.transliteration: karṇakaśca ṛṣiḥ siddhas tathā pūrvātithiśca yaḥ
verses.translation: There, VedavySsa becomes pleased and fulfils the desires of the devotee. One who lits up a wick on a platform after tying it round with thread remains in the region of Rudra till the end of the cycle. Afterwards the devotee should go to the Airandi-tirtha and bathe at the junction of rivers which liberates him from all sins. The river Airandi is revowned in all the three worlds and is the dispeller of all sins. The devotee should observe a complete fast after bathing there on the 8th day of the bright fortnight in the month of Aiivin and then he should feed a Br&hmapa. He gets the benefit of feeding crores of Brfihmapas. One who dives in the sacred stream after rubbing on his head tlra earth of that place is freed from all his sins. One who circumambulates that sacred plac e gets the merits of circumambulating idl the world along with theseven oceans. Afterwards one who gives away gold in charity after bathing in the water mingled with gold enjoys in Rudraloka seated iu a Vim&na of gold and is born as a king. Afterwards the devotee should go to the junction of the river Hikeu. That lautiful ttrtha is renowned in the three worlds and the Lord iva resides there. — 40-48.
verses.wordMeaning: There, VedavySsa becomes pleased and fulfils the desires of the devotee. One who lits up a wick on a platform after tying it round with thread remains in the region of Rudra till the end of the cycle.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There, VedavySsa becomes pleased and fulfils the desires of the devotee. One who lits up a wick on a platform after tying it round with thread remains in the region of Rudra till the end of the cycle.…
verses.science: मार्कण्डेयजीने कहा--राजन्! तभीसे ब्रह्मा आदि नर्मदाका सेवन करते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते त्वत्रयः प्रोक्ता मन्त्रकृत्षण्महर्षयः वसिष्ठश्चैव शक्तिश्च तृतीयश्च पराशरः
verses.transliteration: ityete tvatrayaḥ proktā mantrakṛtṣaṇmaharṣayaḥ vasiṣṭhaścaiva śaktiśca tṛtīyaśca parāśaraḥ
verses.translation: The person bathing there becomes one of the chief attendants of TUB UATSYA PUBANAM,
verses.commentary: Sense: The person bathing there becomes one of the chief attendants of TUB UATSYA PUBANAM,
verses.science: युधिष्ठिरने पूछा-मुनिश्रेष्ठ! इस पृथ्वीपर महादेवजीका त्रिशूल किस स्थानपर गिरा था? उस स्थानका पुण्य यथार्थरूपसे बतलाइये मार्कण्डेयजी बोले-वह महान् पुण्यमय तीर…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु इन्द्रप्रतिमः पञ्चमस्तु भरद्वसुः षष्ठस्तु मित्रावरुणः सत्तमः कुण्डिनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: tatastu indrapratimaḥ pañcamastu bharadvasuḥ ṣaṣṭhastu mitrāvaruṇaḥ sattamaḥ kuṇḍinastathā
verses.translation: iva. Then the Svfimik&rtika-tlrtha — the dispeller of all sins — should be visited. Merely by bathing there the devotee is purified of three kinds of sins. Then the devotee should bathe at Lingas&ra-tirtha by doing TThich one gets the merit of having given away a thousand cows in charity and he resides in the realm of Rudra. Bhanga-tlrtha is the dispeller of all sins. By bathing there the sins of the seven generations are annihilah ed.— 49-52.
verses.wordMeaning: iva. Then the Svfimik&rtika-tlrtha — the dispeller of all sins — should be visited. Merely by bathing there the devotee is purified of three kinds of sins.…
verses.commentary: Sense: iva. Then the Svfimik&rtika-tlrtha — the dispeller of all sins — should be visited. Merely by bathing there the devotee is purified of three kinds of sins.…
verses.science: नन्दिकेशं परिष्वज्य पर्याप्तं जन्मनः फलम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते सप्त विज्ञेया वासिष्ठा ब्रह्मवादिनः विश्वामित्रश्च गाधेयो देवरातस्तथा बलः
verses.transliteration: ityete sapta vijñeyā vāsiṣṭhā brahmavādinaḥ viśvāmitraśca gādheyo devarātastathā balaḥ
verses.translation: Then Batedvara the foremost of all the sacred places should be visited. By bathing there one gets the merit of having given away thousand cows. — 53. Sanme4a-tirtha is venerated by all the Devas, by bathing there one becomes like Indra. — 54.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Batedvara the foremost of all the sacred places should be visited. By bathing there one gets the merit of having given away thousand cows. — 53. Sanme4a-tirtha is venerated by all the Devas, by bathing there one becomes like Indra. — 54.
verses.science: तेषां शिरांस्यगृह्णन्त सर्वे देवाः समागताः तस्तु संस्थापितो देवः शूलपाणिर्वृषध्वजः। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा विद्वान्मधुच्छन्दा ऋषिश्चान्यो ऽघमर्षणः अष्टको लोहितश्चैव भृतकीलश्च माम्बुधिः
verses.transliteration: tathā vidvānmadhucchandā ṛṣiścānyo 'ghamarṣaṇaḥ aṣṭako lohitaścaiva bhṛtakīlaśca māmbudhiḥ
verses.translation: By bathing at Koti-tirtha one undoubtedly becomes the ruler of a kingdom. One who gives any charity there gets manifold blessings. Any woman bathing there becomes the queen of Indra after becoming beautiful like Pirvatl. — 55-57.
verses.hindi: गाधि-नन्दन विश्वामित्र, देवरात, बल, विद्वान् मधुच्छन्दा, अघमर्षण, अष्टक, लोहित, भृतकील,अम्बुधि, देवपरायण देवरात, प्राचीन ऋषि धनञ्जय, शिशिर तथा महान् तेजस्वी शालंकायन—इन तेरहोंको कौशिकवंशोत्पन्न ब्रह्मवादी ऋषि समझना चाहिये। अगस्त्य, दृढद्युम्न तथा इन्द्रबाहु—ये तीनों परम यशस्वी ब्रह्मवादी ऋषि अगस्त्य-कुलमें उत्पन्न हुए हैं। विवस्वान्-पुत्र मनु तथा इला-नन्दन राजा पुरूरवा—क्षत्रिय-कुलमें उत्पन्न हुए इन दोनों राजर्षियोंको मन्त्रवादी जानना चाहिये। भलन्दक, वासाश्व और संकील—वैश्योंमें श्रेष्ठ इन तीनोंको मन्त्रकर्ता समझना चाहिये। इस प्रकार ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय और वैश्य-कुलमें उत्पन्न हुए बानबे ऋषियोंका वर्णन किया गया, जिन्होंने मन्त्रोंको प्रकट किया है। अब ऋषि-पुत्रोंके विषयमें सुनिये। ये ऋषिपुत्र जो श्रुतर्षि कहलाते हैं, ऋषियोंके पुत्र हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: By bathing at Koti-tirtha one undoubtedly becomes the ruler of a kingdom. One who gives any charity there gets manifold blessings. Any woman bathing there becomes the queen of Indra after becoming beautiful like Pirvatl. — 55-57.
verses.science: तदाप्रभृति लोकानां स्वर्गमार्गो निवारितः। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवश्रवा देवरातः पुराणश्च धनंजयः शिशिरश्च महातेजाः शालङ्कायन एव च
verses.transliteration: devaśravā devarātaḥ purāṇaśca dhanaṃjayaḥ śiśiraśca mahātejāḥ śālaṅkāyana eva ca
verses.translation: Angarea-tirtha should be visited next. By doing it one remains in bliss till the destruction of the universe. — 58-59. One who bathes at Ayonisambhava-tirtha never experiences the sufferings of birth after which the devotee should bathe at P&ndavefla. — 60.
verses.commentary: Sense: Angarea-tirtha should be visited next. By doing it one remains in bliss till the destruction of the universe. — 58-59. One who bathes at Ayonisambhava-tirtha never experiences the sufferings of birth after which the devotee should bathe at P&ndavefla. — 60.
verses.science: स्वर्गादेत्य भवेद् राजा राज्यं कृत्वा दिवं व्रजेत् स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र सर्वयज्ञफलं लभेत् नराणां पापनाशाय ह्यगस्त्येश्वरमुत्तमम्। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोदशैते विज्ञेया ब्रह्मिष्ठाः कौशिका वराः अगस्त्यो ऽथ दृढद्युम्न इन्द्रबाहुस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: trayodaśaite vijñeyā brahmiṣṭhāḥ kauśikā varāḥ agastyo 'tha dṛḍhadyumna indrabāhustathaiva ca
verses.translation: By bathing there one gets lasting happiness and becomes invulner- able even by the Devas and goes and enjoys in the realm of Vispu and on being reborn he becomes a king. Then the devotee should bathe at Kathe- 4vara tirtha and his desires are fulfilled by remaining there during the sum- mer solstice. Afterwards he should bathe in the river Chandrabh4g3. — 61-63.
verses.wordMeaning: By bathing there one gets lasting happiness and becomes invulner- able even by the Devas and goes and enjoys in the realm of Vispu and on being reborn he becomes a king.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By bathing there one gets lasting happiness and becomes invulner- able even by the Devas and goes and enjoys in the realm of Vispu and on being reborn he becomes a king.…
verses.science: तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् ब्रह्मलोके महीयते। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मिष्ठागस्तयो ह्येते त्रयः परमकीर्तयः मनुर्वैवस्वतश्चैव ऐलो राजा पुरूरवाः
verses.transliteration: brahmiṣṭhāgastayo hyete trayaḥ paramakīrtayaḥ manurvaivasvataścaiva ailo rājā purūravāḥ
verses.translation: The devotee bathing in the Chandrabhngfi goes to the region of the Moon. Afterwards he should visit the ludra-tirtha where Indra performed his worship. One who gives away gold in charity after bathing there or a black bull, remains in the realm of iva for as many years as there arei hair on the body of that bull and on its calf. He is afterwards reborn as a valiant king and is the master of thousands of white horses. — 64-68. Then the devotee should bathe at the Brahmfivarta-tirtha and offer libation to the manes and the Devas and observe a fast for the night. One who offers the balls of rice to the manes on the Kany4-Bankr&.nta gets innumerable blessings.— 69-70.
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee bathing in the Chandrabhngfi goes to the region of the Moon. Afterwards he should visit the ludra-tirtha where Indra performed his worship. One who gives away gold in charity after bathing there or a black bull,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee bathing in the Chandrabhngfi goes to the region of the Moon. Afterwards he should visit the ludra-tirtha where Indra performed his worship. One who gives away gold in charity after bathing there or a black bull,…
verses.science: भोजनं चैव विप्राणां सर्व कोटिगुणं भवेत् ततो गच्छेच्च राजेन्द्र बलाकेश्वरमुत्तमम्। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियाणां वरा ह्येते विज्ञेया मन्त्रवादिनः भलन्दकश्च वासाश्वः संकीलश्चैव ते त्रयः
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyāṇāṃ varā hyete vijñeyā mantravādinaḥ bhalandakaśca vāsāśvaḥ saṃkīlaścaiva te trayaḥ
verses.translation: One who gives away a milch cow after bathing at Kapila-tirtha gets the benefit of having given away the whole world in charity. The sacred place Narmadeffa is unparalleled. — 71-72.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who gives away a milch cow after bathing at Kapila-tirtha gets the benefit of having given away the whole world in charity. The sacred place Narmadeffa is unparalleled. — 71-72.
verses.science: जाता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: एते मन्त्रकृतो ज्ञेया वैश्यानां प्रवराः सदा इति द्विनवतिः प्रोक्ता मन्त्रायैश्च बहिष्कृताः
verses.transliteration: ete mantrakṛto jñeyā vaiśyānāṃ pravarāḥ sadā iti dvinavatiḥ proktā mantrāyaiśca bahiṣkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The person bathing there gets the merit of having performed Aifva- medba sacrifice. Sangameivara-tirtba is on the northern bank of the Nar- inadi. By bathing there the devotee gets the benefit of all the sacrifices. There the man doing even the smallest act of virtue becomes free from all ills and attains kingship. On the same bank of the Narmadfi is the Parmaifobhana-tirtha which is the best place of Aditya and Lord iva has said that any charity performed there begets everlasting merits. OBAPTEn CXCt
